Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Posizione : Data Analyst

Sede : San Vittore Olona – Milano

Tipo di Impiego : Tempo pieno

Settore / Divisione : IT

RAL: Da definire

Livello : Livello intermedio (5-8 anni)

Tipo di Contratto: Tempo Indeterminato

Riporto : Global IT Manager / Data Lead

Area Operativa: Data & Analytics







Panoramica

Chematek è in forte espansione nella propria infrastruttura dati: stiamo costruendo un moderno data stack su Snowflake e Azure, integrando fonti ERP, CRM e operative provenienti da più paesi. Cerchiamo un Data Analyst con solide basi su data warehousing e una concreta voglia di crescere verso ML e AI applicata al business.




L’azienda

Chematek è un distributore di servizi tecnici, integrati e industriali, focalizzato sui settori della chimica fine, della petrolchimica, dell’ingegneria, approvvigionamento e costruzione (EPC) e dei lubrificanti. Opera attraverso 9 centri geografici ben integrati, con sede centrale nel Nord Italia.

Chematek è un’azienda a proprietà privata, attiva da oltre 40 anni. La società ha la missione di sviluppare i mercati e commercializzare prodotti differenziati e di eccellenza nei propri settori di riferimento, garantendo al contempo un servizio e una consegna eccellenti, solidi e affidabili alla propria ampia clientela globale.




Descrizione del ruolo

La risorsa lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Data Lead e con i partner di implementazione, partecipando attivamente alla costruzione e all’evoluzione della piattaforma dati aziendale.




Mansioni e responsabilità

Progettare e mantenere modelli dbt su Snowflake in collaborazione con il Data Lead
Costruire e ottimizzare pipeline ADF per l’ingestion da Business Central, HubSpot, Xero e altri sistemi operativi
Sviluppare report e dashboard su Power BI per le divisioni aziendali
Applicare modelli ML su dati aziendali per supportare analisi predittive e ottimizzazione operativa
Garantire qualità, documentazione e governance dei dati (GDPR); collaborare con i partner IT esterni nelle fasi di knowledge transfer







Requisiti del candidato

5–8 anni di esperienza in ruoli analitici (data analyst, BI developer, data engineer)
Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica o equivalente
Snowflake – modellazione, query optimization, cost monitoring, RBAC di base
SQL avanzato – window functions, CTE, ottimizzazione query su larga scala
Azure – Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2, ambienti cloud-native
dbt (data build tool) – modelli, tests, documentazione, lineage
Python – pandas, numpy, scripting di automazione e data prep
Power BI o Tableau (almeno uno a livello operativo; conoscenza dell’altro apprezzata)
Data modeling – star schema, dimensioni SCD, data vault di base
Plus apprezzati: ML applicato (scikit-learn), Azure ML / Azure AI Services, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Italiano ed inglese fluente scritto e parlato (ambiente internazionale)
Disponibilità a lavorare in full presence – San Vittore Olona, Milano




Prego inviare cv a : careers@chematek.com

Title: Data Scientist GenAI
Description:
Are you looking for a new challenge?

Fancy helping us shape the future of motor insurance?

Prima could be the place for you.

Since 2015, we’ve been using our love of data and tech to rethink motor insurance and bring drivers a great experience at a great price. Our story began in Italy, where we’ve quickly become the number one online motor insurance provider. In fact, we’re trusted by over 5 million drivers. And now we’re expanding to help millions more drivers in the UK and Spain.

We’re looking for a Data Scientist to join our AI team focused on bringing ML & Generative AI into the heart of our operations (e.g. claims, underwriting, customer support).

In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to redefine the core operative processes, leveraging ML & GenAI techniques to enhance not only efficiency but, most importantly, the overall effectiveness and quality of outcomes.

You’ll collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business leaders to design and deliver AI-driven products that create tangible business value and redefine the future of ops at Prima.

Excited to make an impact? Here are the details

What You’ll Do


Leverage Machine Learning and GenAI to solve complex business problems, making our processes better and faster;
Analyze and interpret complex data to support decision-making;
Contribute directly to Prima’s long-term success and financial impact through concrete solutions.


What We’re Looking For


Strong academic background in quantitative fields such as Math, Physics, Data Science, or Engineering;
All experience levels, including recent graduates with no prior working experience;
Strong analytical and quantitative skills;
Structured problem solving skills and being able to analyze and break down complex problems;
Curiosity, proactivity, quick learning and an innovative mindset.


Nice-to-Have


Hands-on experience with Python and coding best practices;
Experience with machine learning and Generative AI (openAI/Gemini APIs, agentic frameworks, …)
Business proficiency in Italian or Spanish, in addition to English.


€38,000 - €55,000 a year

Why you’ll love it here

We want to make Prima a happy and empowering place to work. So if you decide to join us, you can expect plenty of perks..

🤸 Work Your Way: Enjoy full flexibility – work from home, the office or a mix of both. Plus, work from anywhere for up to 30 days a year.

🏁 Grow with us: We may move fast at Prima, but we move together. Get access to learning resources, mentorship and a growth plan tailored to you.

🌈 Thrive and perform: Your best work begins when you feel your best. Enjoy private healthcare, gym discounts, wellbeing programs and mental health support.

Think you’re a match? Apply now.

At Prima, we celebrate uniqueness. If you don’t meet every requirement but are passionate about this role, we still want to hear from you. Innovation thrives on diverse perspectives.

Prima is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. Need accommodations during the process? Email us at accessible.recruiting@prima.it. Let’s build the future of insurance, together.

Title: Lead Data Scientist
Description:
Enabling What’s Next




Who We Are😎

Born in 2004 as Techedge, we have more than 20 years of expertise that enabled us to become what we are today: Avvale!

This path led us to be able to count on over 3500 employees, present in 12 countries around the world.




What We Do🌱

We help public and private companies to re-design their business models through the development of innovative and sustainable solutions, which have a positive impact not only on our customers but also on the world we live in!




How we do💡

Through circular economy models, made possible thanks to technological innovation.




What you will find 🔍

In Avvale we value our talents and your path with us will be full of:

Flexibility, thanks to our policy you can work remotely in Italy, up to 5 days a week, and in SEE and Switzerland up to 5 months a year;

Training & development as you can participate to training on the job, certifications, foreign languages classes and you will have a yearly budget to buy training courses;

Gender equality & inclusion, the obtaining of Pdr 125 is a proof of Avvale commitment to an inclusive and fair work environment;

Compensation & Benefits: In line with our commitment to transparency and people development, the gross annual salary (RAL) for this position ranges between €44,000 and €50,000, commensurate with experience and skills. The position is covered by the 'CCNL Commercio e Terziario' (National Collective Labor Agreement for Commerce and Service Sector), alongside a benefits package that includes meal vouchers, wellbeing initiatives (including Wellhub), and growth opportunities.




Role and responsibilities:




You will be part of an area that takes care of Artificial Intelligence.




As a Lead Data Scientist, you will work for customers and internal research departments on complex and innovative projects about genAI, NLP, demand forecasting, predictive maintenance, computer vision, and lots more, in various fields and sectors.

You will focus on solving complex problems: translating requirements into actionable rules and

deliverables.




You will be responsible for:

Analyzing business needs and proposing the most effective technical approach, choosing between classical AI, GenAI, or hybrid solutions.
Designing the end-to-end AI solution, translating business requirements into technical specifications.
Designing and implementing solutions based on Machine Learning and advanced statistical methods, as well as GenAI architectures (RAG, agents, LLM orchestration, prompt engineering, fine-tuning when needed).
Assessing when to rely on an LLM/GenAI solution versus a classical ML approach, based on robustness, accuracy, and cost-effectiveness.
Validating developed models with a focus on explainability, generalization, robustness, and production behavior (including GenAI-specific risks such as hallucinations, bias, and inference costs).
Preparing and presenting technical and non-technical reports, adapting the storytelling to the audience's level.
Staying up to date on developments in Data Science, ML, and GenAI, proposing new ideas and participating in pre-sales activities.




Required Skills🛹

At least 4 years of relevant experience designing and implementing AI/ML solutions.
Hands-on experience applying advanced analytics/ML techniques to real business cases, with a proven ability to synthesize complex data and present results.
Practical experience with advanced analytics/ML techniques and GenAI solutions applied to real business cases .
Strong proficiency in Python and core AI frameworks/libraries.




Come with us💪

You will have the opportunity to work and get in touch with international players who will allow you to increase your know-how in view of future challenges!




We do not consider applications without CV.

Avvale promotes equal opportunity. We enhance diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment in compliance with applicable non-discrimination and data protection laws.

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
At Lexroom, we set the bar for legal AI—clear, fast, and built for trust.

In just a few years, what began as an idea has become a reliable platform adopted by thousands of legal professionals across Europe.

Our mission is clear: make the law faster, clearer, and more reliable, giving lawyers, law firms, and companies the time and confidence to focus on what truly matters.

We're scaling rapidly, backed by top-tier investors and a world-class team dedicated to rigor, clarity, and impact.

Today, Lexroom is a trusted partner, shaping the future of legal AI with discipline and purpose.

Why Lexroom?


Shape the Standard: Be part of the team setting the benchmark for legal AI in Europe.
Work with the Best: Collaborate with exceptional colleagues in a culture that values competence, curiosity, and ambition.
Deliver Meaningful Results: Your work will directly influence how legal professionals operate—faster, clearer, and more efficiently.


At Lexroom, we leave buzzwords behind. Here, you'll build something that lasts: a trusted platform, a strong reputation, a new standard for the legal world.

What You'll Do


Own the data transformation layer from raw sources to trusted, documented datasets—designing and maintaining a dbt project on BigQuery with staging, intermediate, and mart layers.
Model product analytics events (user interactions, feature adoption, feedback signals), engineering metrics, and business KPIs into reliable, self-service data models.
Build and maintain the data foundations powering our dashboards, decisions, and team health metrics.
Implement data quality frameworks: tests, freshness checks, anomaly detection, and clear ownership and SLAs on key datasets.
Collaborate with engineers to improve event tracking and data contracts at the source (Pub/Sub, application events).
Create and curate dashboards and semantic layers that Product, CS, and Sales teams can query directly—enabling true self-service analytics.
Partner with the AI & Search Platform team to instrument and measure model performance, feedback loops, and benchmark results.
Support Product teams with ad-hoc analysis: feature impact, user segmentation, satisfaction trends, and power-user behavior.


What You'll Bring


3+ years of experience in analytics engineering, data engineering, or a data analyst role with a strong engineering mindset.
Expert SQL skills and hands-on experience with dbt (dbt Core or dbt Cloud).
Solid experience with BigQuery or comparable cloud data warehouses (Snowflake, Redshift).
Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data testing, and documentation-as-code practices.
Comfortable working in a Python ecosystem (scripting, basic ETL, notebooks for exploration).
Experience building data models that serve multiple stakeholders (product, engineering, business).
Fluent English; Italian is a strong plus.


Nice to Have


Experience with event-driven architectures (Pub/Sub, Kafka) and streaming data.
Familiarity with Elasticsearch, Pinecone, or vector databases.
Exposure to engineering metrics (DORA, PR analytics) or developer productivity measurement.
Experience with BI/visualization tools (Retool, Looker Studio, Metabase).
Interest in AI/ML model evaluation and LLM output quality measurement.
Previous experience in legal-tech, RegTech, or B2B SaaS.


What Sets Us Apart

An Exceptional Team

At Lexroom, you'll work alongside top talent in tech and legal AI.

Our focused teams operate with purpose and autonomy, so every contribution delivers visible results.

You'll collaborate with people who pair innovation with rigor, curiosity with discipline, ambition with depth.

A Foundational Role

This is our first dedicated analytics hire. You won't inherit a legacy stack or fight bureaucracy—you'll design the analytics function from scratch with direct executive sponsorship, a modern stack (BigQuery, dbt, Pub/Sub, Python, GCP), and real strategic impact from day one.

Growth that Matters

We hire exceptional people to make a difference—and we give them space to lead.

Your work will shape the future of legal technology and set new standards for the field.

Impact is defined by vision and execution, not by age or title. If you're ready to take responsibility, you'll find real opportunities to grow and lead high-stakes projects.

Rewarding Your Contribution

We value excellence and share success:


Annual Salary Range: €45,000 – €70,000
Equity Package: Align your growth with the company's long-term success.


Benefits That Matter


Hybrid Work: Flexibility to balance remote work with in-person collaboration at our Milan HQ.
Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to ensure peace of mind.
Meal Vouchers: Daily support to make your lunch breaks easier.
Performance Bonuses: Rewards tied directly to measurable results.
Team Retreats & Off-sites: Dedicated time to connect, collaborate, and spark bold ideas.


At Lexroom, ambition meets discipline and purpose. We're not just building a product—we're setting a new standard for the legal world. If you're ready to contribute to something lasting and meaningful, we'd love to hear from you.

Compensation Range: €45K - €70K

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Posizione : Data Analyst

Sede : San Vittore Olona – Milano

Tipo di Impiego : Tempo pieno

Settore / Divisione : IT

RAL: Da definire

Livello : Livello intermedio (5-8 anni)

Tipo di Contratto: Tempo Indeterminato

Riporto : Global IT Manager / Data Lead

Area Operativa: Data & Analytics







Panoramica

Chematek è in forte espansione nella propria infrastruttura dati: stiamo costruendo un moderno data stack su Snowflake e Azure, integrando fonti ERP, CRM e operative provenienti da più paesi. Cerchiamo un Data Analyst con solide basi su data warehousing e una concreta voglia di crescere verso ML e AI applicata al business.




L’azienda

Chematek è un distributore di servizi tecnici, integrati e industriali, focalizzato sui settori della chimica fine, della petrolchimica, dell’ingegneria, approvvigionamento e costruzione (EPC) e dei lubrificanti. Opera attraverso 9 centri geografici ben integrati, con sede centrale nel Nord Italia.

Chematek è un’azienda a proprietà privata, attiva da oltre 40 anni. La società ha la missione di sviluppare i mercati e commercializzare prodotti differenziati e di eccellenza nei propri settori di riferimento, garantendo al contempo un servizio e una consegna eccellenti, solidi e affidabili alla propria ampia clientela globale.




Descrizione del ruolo

La risorsa lavorerà a stretto contatto con il Data Lead e con i partner di implementazione, partecipando attivamente alla costruzione e all’evoluzione della piattaforma dati aziendale.




Mansioni e responsabilità

Progettare e mantenere modelli dbt su Snowflake in collaborazione con il Data Lead
Costruire e ottimizzare pipeline ADF per l’ingestion da Business Central, HubSpot, Xero e altri sistemi operativi
Sviluppare report e dashboard su Power BI per le divisioni aziendali
Applicare modelli ML su dati aziendali per supportare analisi predittive e ottimizzazione operativa
Garantire qualità, documentazione e governance dei dati (GDPR); collaborare con i partner IT esterni nelle fasi di knowledge transfer







Requisiti del candidato

5–8 anni di esperienza in ruoli analitici (data analyst, BI developer, data engineer)
Laurea in Informatica, Ingegneria, Statistica, Matematica o equivalente
Snowflake – modellazione, query optimization, cost monitoring, RBAC di base
SQL avanzato – window functions, CTE, ottimizzazione query su larga scala
Azure – Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob Storage / ADLS Gen2, ambienti cloud-native
dbt (data build tool) – modelli, tests, documentazione, lineage
Python – pandas, numpy, scripting di automazione e data prep
Power BI o Tableau (almeno uno a livello operativo; conoscenza dell’altro apprezzata)
Data modeling – star schema, dimensioni SCD, data vault di base
Plus apprezzati: ML applicato (scikit-learn), Azure ML / Azure AI Services, Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central
Italiano ed inglese fluente scritto e parlato (ambiente internazionale)
Disponibilità a lavorare in full presence – San Vittore Olona, Milano




Prego inviare cv a : careers@chematek.com

Title: Data Scientist – Growth e Automazione
Description:
Cerchiamo un/una Growth Analytics & Automation Specialist per costruire l'ossatura dati dei nostri business digitali.

Creiamo, lanciamo e scaliamo prodotti B2C e B2B attraverso il performance marketing, e ora vogliamo alzare l'asticella su come usiamo dati e automazione per prendere decisioni. Non cerchiamo qualcuno che si limiti a costruire dashboard. Cerchiamo una persona che gestisca il dato end-to-end e che si chieda di continuo: cosa sta succedendo? Perché? Cosa facciamo al riguardo? E, quando possibile, come lo automatizziamo?

Di cosa ti occuperai

Monitorare e analizzare le performance di prodotti, campagne, funnel e checkout
Presidiare KPI come CAC, CPA, ROAS, MER, tasso di conversione, LTV, retention e churn
Verificare e correggere problemi di tracciamento e attribuzione su piattaforme adv, CRM, checkout e payment processor
Costruire dashboard e sistemi di alert per il management e i team performance
Indagare le anomalie e risalire alle cause reali, senza fermarti ai sintomi
Lavorare a stretto contatto con gli sviluppatori per migliorare tracciamento e flusso dei dati
Individuare le attività manuali e ripetitive e contribuire ad automatizzarle: dall'insight all'azione

Cosa cerchiamo

Esperienza pratica e solida con Meta Ads, Google Ads, GA4/GTM
SQL e ottime capacità di analisi dei dati
Esperienza nella creazione di dashboard e reportistica BI
Una reale comprensione tecnica di come i dati vengono generati, raccolti e archiviati
Curiosità, ragionamento lucido e capacità di entrare velocemente in sistemi sconosciuti

Nice to have: Python, tracciamento server-side, Meta CAPI, BigQuery/data warehouse, webhook, strumenti di automazione, sperimentazione e anomaly detection.

Perché questo ruolo

Accesso diretto sia a chi prende le decisioni di business sia a chi costruisce i sistemi. Responsabilità che cresce, non solo una lista di task che si allunga. L'occasione di definire fin da subito il modo in cui l'azienda usa i dati.

📍 Milano | 🏢 In sede | 🕐 Full-time | 🗣️ Inglese professionale richiesto

Come candidarsi

Inviaci il tuo CV insieme a una breve storia: raccontaci un problema reale che hai scoperto grazie ai dati (un bug di tracciamento, una campagna che sembrava funzionare ma non era così, un'automazione che hai costruito). Cosa hai notato, cosa hai fatto e com'è andata a finire.

L'annuncio è rivolto a candidati di tutti i generi (L. 903/77 e L. 125/91).

Title: Graduate data scientist
Description:
At Bending Spoons, we’re striving to build one of the all-time great companies. A company that serves a huge number of customers. A company where team members grow to their full potential. A company that functions at unparalleled levels of effectiveness and efficiency. A company that creates value for shareowners at an extraordinary rate. And a company that does so while adhering to high ethical standards.

In pursuit of this objective, we acquire and improve digital businesses, not to sell on, but to own and operate for the long term. The transformations we make are often deep—designed to speed up innovation, benefit customers, and strengthen business performance. Here, hierarchy is minimal and teams are small and talent-dense. We operate established products with the ambition, agility, and urgency of a startup. Across the company, we integrate AI deeply into how we work so that human judgment and machine intelligence reinforce each other.

For a talented, driven, and collaborative individual, working at Bending Spoons is an opportunity to learn, make an impact, and progress their career at an exceptionally high rate. That’s our promise to such a candidate.

A few examples of your responsibilities
Design and improve data pipelines. Contribute to the design and evolution of data systems—ensuring data is accurate, reliable, and efficiently processed across diverse tech stacks.
Ensure data correctness and scalability. Work closely with software engineers to validate data, define metrics, and improve the robustness of reporting and analytics systems.
Develop internal data products and tooling. Help build scalable solutions (e.g., reporting engines, forecasting tools) used by product teams across the company.
Support platform-wide decision-making. Partner with multiple teams to provide the analytical and modeling backbone for business planning and performance tracking.
Leverage AI to accelerate work and uncover insights. Use AI tools to move faster, surface ideas and opportunities, and study competing products and trends.


What we look for
Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.


What we offer
Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.


Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

  • Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer
  • Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
  • An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. Spooners in their 20s lead products worth hundreds of millions of dollars. And if you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects, too.
  • All. These. Benefits. Flexible hours, remote working, unlimited backing for learning and training, top-of-the-market health insurance, a rich relocation package, generous parental support, and a yearly retreat to a stunning location. We help each Spooner set up the conditions to do their best work.
  • Competitive pay and access to company equity at a discount. Typical annual salary offers range from £85,797 to £151,436 in London and from €66,065 to €107,837 elsewhere in Europe. The lower end of these ranges applies to candidates with little or no relevant experience, while exceptionally experienced candidates may receive offers of up to £316,052 in London or €240,330 elsewhere in Europe. Candidates offered a permanent contract may choose to receive part of their compensation in discounted company equity.

Commitment & contract
Permanent or fixed-term. Full-time or part-time.

Location
Milan (Italy), London (UK), Madrid (Spain), Warsaw (Poland), or fully remote from eligible countries.

The selection process
In our screening process, we prioritize verifiable signals of excellence, regardless of seniority. There are no preferential paths beyond what your application demonstrates, and we evaluate every candidate through the same process.

Some people hold back because they feel they lack experience or have an “imperfect” CV. If you like the role and believe you could excel over time, don’t self-reject.

All applications go through our careers page, which is the only way to be considered. If you pass our screening, you’ll be asked to complete one or more tests. They are challenging, may involve unfamiliar problems, and can take several hours. To learn more about what to expect throughout the selection process, you can find additional information here.

We set the bar high and won’t extend an offer until we’re confident we’ve found the right candidate. This is why a job may remain open for months or be reposted several times.

We consider all applicants for employment and provide reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities—please let us know through this form.

Before you apply
If you’ve applied before but didn't receive an offer, we recommend waiting at least one year before applying again.

Bending Spoons is a demanding environment. We’re extremely ambitious and we hold ourselves—and one another—to a high standard. While this tends to lead to extraordinary learning, achievement, and career growth, it also requires significant commitment.

To help you ramp up quickly and set yourself up for success, we expect you to spend most days in our Milan office during your first few months with us, regardless of your long-term work location. It’s the best way to rapidly absorb our company culture and build trust with your new teammates. We’ll support you with generous travel and accommodation assistance. After that, you’re welcome to work from one of our offices, or remotely from approved countries—depending on what we agree at the offer stage.

If the role speaks to you and you’re excited to give your best, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now—we can’t wait to meet you.

Title: Data Science Manager
Description:
About us

With an IP-first approach, we design cutting-edge technology platforms – Sky Stream, Sky Q, Sky Glass, and NOW – that bring together premium content, trusted news, and world-class sports within a simple and intuitive ecosystem.

We connect with audiences across Italy through our free-to-air channels – TV8, Cielo, and Sky TG24 – and go beyond entertainment with Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile, offering ultra-fast connectivity at home and on the go.

This is how we deliver the joy of a better experience, guided by our values:

Creative. We are ambitious and innovative, embracing new technologies and leveraging insights to stay one step ahead, continuously raising the bar for our customers.

Welcoming. We are inclusive, collaborative, and respectful, creating a strong sense of belonging.

Simplifying. We focus on what matters most, set clear priorities, bring clarity, and remove complexity.

Do the Right Thing. We build a culture of clarity, fairness, and trust, supported by transparent processes and decisions people can rely on.




Role: Manager Data Scientist

We are looking for a Data Science Manager who combines strong hands-on expertise with strategic leadership.

This is not a traditional people-management role: you will operate primarily as a senior individual contributor, while acting as the data science lead on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives. You will own complex projects end-to-end, partnering with business and technology stakeholders to turn data into measurable business impact.

You will play a pivotal role in bridging business challenges and advanced analytics, shaping how data science is applied across the organization and elevating both its impact and maturity.

What you will do:

Lead data science projects from problem framing to production deployment
Make key decisions on methodology, trade-offs, and technical direction
Develop and deploy machine learning and AI models to drive customer value and operational efficiency
Act as Data Lead on strategic initiatives, and serve as the go-to data science expert on critical, cross-functional programs
Translate ambiguous business questions into structured analytical problems
Drive alignment between stakeholders and ensure delivery of tangible, measurable outcomes
Stay deeply hands-on
Apply advanced analytics techniques in complex, multi-source and big data environments
Promote high standards in code quality, reproducibility, and model governance
Support adoption of responsible and ethical AI practices
Provide guidance and mentorship to junior data scientists
Foster a culture of ownership, pragmatism, and continuous improvement
Partner with business stakeholders to identify high-impact opportunities
Communicate complex analytical insights in a clear, compelling, and actionable way
Drive data adoption and data-driven decision making across the organization




Your profile:

Almeno 4 years of experience in data science or advanced analytics roles
Proven ability to own projects end-to-end in production environments
Strong track record of working in ambiguous, fast-paced environments
Natural ownership mindset: you don’t just build models—you drive impact
Machine learning (supervised, unsupervised, semi-supervised)
Statistical modeling and experimentation
Advanced proficiency in: Python (Pandas, NumPy, Scikit-learn, etc.), SQL, and/or R
Productionization and collaboration with engineering teams
Solid understanding of Data pipelines and large-scale data processing
Experience with version control (Git)
Ability to connect data work to real business outcomes and KPIs
Experience interacting with stakeholders and influencing decisions
Capability to identify and prioritize high-value use cases
Experience leading projects or initiatives, even without direct reports
Experience mentoring or coaching other data scientists
Fluency in English and Italian is required




What we offer:

For employees covered by the Private Radio and Television Collective Labour Agreement (CCNL), compensation starts from €51,000 gross per year.

Permanent employment contract.
Compensation commensurate with experience and specific skills.
Eligibility for the annual incentive scheme.
Access to Sky’s wellbeing programme, Sky4You, designed to support employees throughout different stages of life. Benefits include:
Free access to Sky TV services through Sky Q or Sky Stream.
Sky Wifi and Sky Mobile at exclusive employee rates.
Private healthcare insurance extendable to family members and cohabitants.
Life and accident insurance.
Free access to the company gym (Milan office only).
Financial support for new parents and caregivers.
Free tax return assistance.
Meal vouchers.
Additional initiatives focused on mental, physical, and financial wellbeing, summer camps and language courses for children, as well as a range of discounts and partnerships.




Hybrid Working

Hybrid working that truly works.

Depending on your role, you can benefit from up to 12 days per month of remote working, while our offices provide inspiring spaces where people collaborate, innovate, and make decisions together.

Our Milan hub is located in Rogoredo, Santa Giulia district, just a few minutes’ walk from Milano Rogoredo Station (M3 Rogoredo FS, regional and high-speed trains, suburban rail services), with convenient bus connections and easy access by car or motorcycle.

At the Sky Campus, you'll find cafés, a company restaurant, Sky Cinema, and collaborative spaces designed to foster innovation and idea-sharing. The surrounding area also offers restaurants, bars, supermarkets, and a wide range of services.




Learning & Development:

At Sky, we invest in your growth.

We believe in internal mobility as a key driver of professional development and offer opportunities to explore new roles and career paths across the organization.

Through Sky Learn, our learning platform, you will have access to continuous training, digital learning content, and upskilling and reskilling programmes to help you grow, evolve, and build your future career.




Social Impact & Inclusion

At Sky, we believe in people.

We are committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone can be themselves and achieve their full potential. We actively support wellbeing and ensure equal opportunities for all, including candidates belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99.

Sky hosts several employee networks, including Body&Mind, LGBTQ+, Women@Sky, and Parents&Carers—voluntary communities that bring colleagues together to promote wellbeing, inclusion, and empowerment initiatives.

We strive every day to create a lasting positive impact on our communities through Sky Cares volunteering programmes, Sky Up digital education initiatives, and immersive educational experiences offered through the Academy Studios.




Why Wait?

Apply now to build an extraordinary career and join a brilliant team.

We can’t wait to meet you. At Sky, ideas become experiences for millions of people.




Sky welcomes every form of talent. All applications, including those from candidates belonging to protected categories under Italian Law 68/99, will be considered based on equal opportunity and inclusion principles, without discrimination of any kind. Sky Italia guarantees a fair, inclusive, and non-discriminatory recruitment process.

In line with this commitment and Legislative Decree 96/2026, Sky Italia does not request or collect information regarding candidates’ previous compensation or employment grading, either during interviews or through any third parties involved in the recruitment process.

Title: Associate Consultant / Consultant in Data Science - AI Engineering
Description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital.



Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility.



We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity.



With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our consultants serve clients worldwide. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.





Descrizione del lavoro



Sia Partners ricerca un Associate Consultant / Consultant - Data Scientist / AI Engineer da inserire in progetti in Italia o all’estero di trasformazione digitale all'interno della Business Line globale di Artificial Intelligence e Data Science.



In Sia Partners il team di AI&DS non solo sviluppa e applica le proprie competenze in ambito Artificial Intelligence e Machine Learning, ma si occupa anche di comprendere fenomeni legati al Business dei nostri Clienti per indirizzarli verso progetti complessi di trasformazione digitali quali journey to cloud, sistemi di computazione avanzata e architetture complesse.



Il nostro obiettivo è quello di estrarre informazioni dalla complessità per permettere ai nostri Clienti di prendere decisioni strategiche.



La persona prescelta si occuperà di:



Sviluppare soluzioni di Artificial Intelligence all’interno dei progetti per i Clienti di riferimento
Comprendere le principali tecnologie a supporto dei progetti di trasformazione digitale
Guidare i Clienti nella comprensione dei rischi/opportunità dei progetti di trasformazione, identificando gli strumenti più adatti per disegnare architetture target
Utilizzare la propria esperienza tecnica in realtà cliente/consulenziali per contribuire alla generazione di insight di business utili per il decision-making

Oltre alle progettualità, alla risorsa inserite sarà richiesto un contributo sulle attività di ricerca e di sviluppo interne, ideazione di nuove soluzioni, casi d'uso ed attività di business development.





Qualifiche



I requisiti indispensabili per entrare a far parte del nostro team sono:



Laurea Specialistica in discipline STEM
prima esperienza in ruoli e/o funzioni di data science e AI
Conoscenza dei principali algoritmi ML e GenAI e delle principali tecnologie per supportare processi di trasformazione
Conoscenza ed esperienza nell’utilizzo di uno o più dei seguenti linguaggi: Python (obbligatorio), R, Matlab, Java
Conoscenza di almeno un servizio AI cloud based tra SageMaker, VertexAI e AzureML
Conoscenza di database strutturati e non strutturati (MySQL, MongoDB, Neo4j, ..)
Esperienza con strumenti di version control (es. Git)
Conoscenza professionale della lingua inglese

Soft Skills:



Spiccate doti comunicative per presentare risultati sia ad un audience tecnico che non
Spiccate doti interpersonali che consentano alla risorsa di lavorare in team e collaborare con i colleghi degli uffici internazionali
Adattabilità e flessibilità
Curiosità


Informazioni aggiuntive



Lavorando in Sia Partners troverai:



Un percorso di carriera dinamico e meritocratico, basato sulle performance;
Un ambiente di lavoro realmente internazionale, dove collaborerai con i data hub degli altri uffici dislocati su scala globale all’interno di Team multidisciplinari.
Una continua crescita e un forte spirito imprenditoriale;
Un rapporto diretto con il top management interno e dei nostri clienti;
Un luogo che abbraccia la concezione di lavoro flessibile e fa propri valori come la fiducia, l’autonomia e il rispetto tra le persone.
Un ambiente dove la diversità e l'inclusività sono il fulcro di ciò che siamo e di come lavoriamo.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.



Sia is an equal opportunity employer. All aspects of employment, including hiring, promotion, remuneration, or discipline, are based solely on performance, competence, conduct, or business needs.

Title: Data Scientist – Senior Consultant
Description:
We are currently looking for an experienced Data Scientist to join our Data & Analytics team.

This position is a unique opportunity to unlock insights contained in the data universe working in a dynamic and innovative environment.

We are looking for candidates with an international background that have experience and strong knowledge in Data Analytics applications in multi-disciplinary environments that provide real-world impact for organizations.

You will be based in our office in Milan (preferably) or in Turin.

Background & Experience


Master's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or related area
4–5 years of experience in Data & Analytics, with proven ability to design and deliver data-driven solutions in business contexts


Technical Skills


Experience in developing and applying analytical models and machine learning techniques to solve real business problems (including both predictive and exploratory approaches)
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with modern data science libraries and frameworks
Experience working with data across the full lifecycle, from data preparation and exploration to model development and deployment
Familiarity with working in cloud-based data and AI environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), leveraging advanced analytics and scalable processing capabilities (e.g. Databricks or similar platforms)
Exposure to Generative AI and LLMs, including use cases such as text analysis, content generation, or process automation
Understanding of prompt engineering principles and ability to integrate LLM-based solutions into data and analytics workflows
Awareness of best practices in model lifecycle management, reproducibility and collaboration within data teams
Ability to understand business requirements and identify the best solution to achieve the expected outcome
Ability to handle an analytical project end-to-end, from business need understanding till results presentation
Ability to communicate both in Italian and English at all levels of the Organization (other European languages will be considered as a plus)
Experience in planning and coordination of project team activities maintaining challenging and collaborative environment
Ability to contribute to the management of a team-oriented environment
Experience in guiding or coaching junior team members within project delivery contexts
Willingness to continuously learn and research on new approach and technologies related to data management and analytics
Highly self-motivated, proactive
A collaborative mindset
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills


Personal Attributes


Highly self-motivated, proactive
A collaborative mindset
Exceptional written and verbal communication skills


You will have an advantage if, additionally, you have:


Previous Consulting and/or professional services experience
Proficiency in R and/or SQL
Experience with Hadoop, Apache Spark
Experience with NLP and text mining
Data Visualization skills on some of leading BI solutions (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik)
Ability to bridge business needs and technical implementation in data and analytics projects
Experience in identifying new business opportunities
Experience in answering to RFIs or RFPs concerning analytics topics or software selection


We want to offer you a unique experience!


You will work in an organization where no two days are the same
You will have the opportunity to work on stand-alone change management projects, or as part of a multi-disciplined team delivering a large-scale technology or organization transformation program
You will work in an international organization that is large enough to offer a wide variety of challenging opportunities, but in a local community where everyone knows your name and are always willing to offer support
You will be supported in continuously growing your career and will have the opportunity to guide and mentor junior team members, contributing to both their technical development and broader professional growth
You will work with other like-minded and creative individuals to develop new ideas that have the potential to make a real difference to the businesses we work with
You will have the opportunity to support the development of new business and service offerings
You will have the opportunity to build strong relationships with BearingPoint top management and companies you will be working with


Are you interested in discovering more about our culture? Let's take a look at our Instagramprofile

About BearingPoint

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. We operate in four units: Consulting, Solutions, Business Services, and Ventures. Consulting covers the advisory business; Solutions provides the tools for successful digital transformation, advanced analytics and regulatory requirements; Business Services provides managed services beyond SaaS; Ventures drives the financing and development of start-ups.

Our clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. We have a global consulting network with more than 10,000 people and support clients in over 75 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success.

We are guided by our purpose – Together, we are more than business.

It revolves around three key areas of focus – More innovation, more for our planet and more for our people. Our people promises – Purpose in Practice, Deeper Connections, New Flexibility, Personal and Professional Growth, and Holistic Wellbeing and Rewards, brings together our values, aspirations, and responsibilities towards our people. It helps our people achieve and accomplish more than you can imagine possible.

We can’t do this alone. We can do this together. Join us!

Interested?

If this sounds like the ideal environment for you to work, innovate and achieve our shared purpose, join our high-performing team, apply now!

Equality & Inclusion

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce where each individual feels they belong. Fostering a work environment with a strong sense of community and where everyone can thrive is a core pillar of our business.

We are focused on attracting and retaining the best people with the right skills and the desire to deliver excellent results, regardless of background. In return, we will provide a working environment in which everyone feels valued and has the opportunity to fulfill their potential, where their talents are fully utilized, and company goals are met. We celebrate the strength that comes from our similarities and our differences through local initiatives which promote inclusion, outreach, and respect.

  • Master's Degree in Statistics, Finance, Business Analytics, Mathematics, Physics, Computer Science or related area
  • 4–5 years of experience in Data & Analytics, with proven ability to design and deliver data-driven solutions in business contexts

Technical Skills

  • Experience in developing and applying analytical models and machine learning techniques to solve real business problems (including both predictive and exploratory approaches)
  • Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with modern data science libraries and frameworks
  • Experience working with data across the full lifecycle, from data preparation and exploration to model development and deployment
  • Familiarity with working in cloud-based data and AI environments (e.g. AWS, Azure, GCP), leveraging advanced analytics and scalable processing capabilities (e.g. Databricks or similar platforms)
  • Exposure to Generative AI and LLMs, including use cases such as text analysis, content generation, or process automation
  • Understanding of prompt engineering principles and ability to integrate LLM-based solutions into data and analytics workflows
  • Awareness of best practices in model lifecycle management, reproducibility and collaboration within data teams
  • Ability to understand business requirements and identify the best solution to achieve the expected outcome
  • Ability to handle an analytical project end-to-end, from business need understanding till results presentation
  • Ability to communicate both in Italian and English at all levels of the Organization (other European languages will be considered as a plus)
  • Experience in planning and coordination of project team activities maintaining challenging and collaborative environment
  • Ability to contribute to the management of a team-oriented environment
  • Experience in guiding or coaching junior team members within project delivery contexts
  • Willingness to continuously learn and research on new approach and technologies related to data management and analytics
  • Highly self-motivated, proactive
  • A collaborative mindset
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

Personal Attributes

  • Highly self-motivated, proactive
  • A collaborative mindset
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills

You will have an advantage if, additionally, you have:

  • Previous Consulting and/or professional services experience
  • Proficiency in R and/or SQL
  • Experience with Hadoop, Apache Spark
  • Experience with NLP and text mining
  • Data Visualization skills on some of leading BI solutions (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, Qlik)
  • Ability to bridge business needs and technical implementation in data and analytics projects
  • Experience in identifying new business opportunities
  • Experience in answering to RFIs or RFPs concerning analytics topics or software selection

We want to offer you a unique experience!

  • You will work in an organization where no two days are the same
  • You will have the opportunity to work on stand-alone change management projects, or as part of a multi-disciplined team delivering a large-scale technology or organization transformation program
  • You will work in an international organization that is large enough to offer a wide variety of challenging opportunities, but in a local community where everyone knows your name and are always willing to offer support
  • You will be supported in continuously growing your career and will have the opportunity to guide and mentor junior team members, contributing to both their technical development and broader professional growth
  • You will work with other like-minded and creative individuals to develop new ideas that have the potential to make a real difference to the businesses we work with
  • You will have the opportunity to support the development of new business and service offerings
  • You will have the opportunity to build strong relationships with BearingPoint top management and companies you will be working with

BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots and a global reach. We operate in four units: Consulting, Solutions, Business Services, and Ventures. Consulting covers the advisory business; Solutions provides the tools for successful digital transformation, advanced analytics and regulatory requirements; Business Services provides managed services beyond SaaS; Ventures drives the financing and development of start-ups.

Our clients include many of the world’s leading companies and organizations. We have a global consulting network with more than 10,000 people and support clients in over 75 countries, engaging with them to achieve measurable and sustainable success.

We are guided by our purpose – Together, we are more than business.

It revolves around three key areas of focus – More innovation, more for our planet and more for our people. Our people promises – Purpose in Practice, Deeper Connections, New Flexibility, Personal and Professional Growth, and Holistic Wellbeing and Rewards, brings together our values, aspirations, and responsibilities towards our people. It helps our people achieve and accomplish more than you can imagine possible.

We can’t do this alone. We can do this together. Join us!

Interested?

If this sounds like the ideal environment for you to work, innovate and achieve our shared purpose, join our high-performing team, apply now!

Equality & Inclusion

BearingPoint is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workforce where each individual feels they belong. Fostering a work environment with a strong sense of community and where everyone can thrive is a core pillar of our business.

We are focused on attracting and retaining the best people with the right skills and the desire to deliver excellent results, regardless of background. In return, we will provide a working environment in which everyone feels valued and has the opportunity to fulfill their potential, where their talents are fully utilized, and company goals are met. We celebrate the strength that comes from our similarities and our differences through local initiatives which promote inclusion, outreach, and respect.

Title: Senior CRM Data Scientist
Description:
Per rafforzare il team CRM stiamo cercando un/a Senior CRM Data Scientist che guidi la costruzione della nostra capability analitica avanzata, sviluppando modelli predittivi, sistemi di segmentazione e insight strategici data-driven a supporto della crescita del valore cliente.

Il/la Senior Customer Intelligence Analyst sarà responsabile dello sviluppo end‑to‑end dei principali modelli di machine learning applicati al CRM, della trasformazione dei dati cliente in insight azionabili e della definizione dei framework analitici alla base delle strategie di personalizzazione, retention e loyalty.

La figura opererà come punto di riferimento tecnico e metodologico per le analisi avanzate, contribuendo attivamente alla roadmap data-driven dell’azienda.




Responsabilità principali:




Customer Intelligence & Advanced Analytics

Progettazione e sviluppo di modelli predittivi avanzati (churn, CLV, propensity, next best action) con Python e SQL.
Costruzione e gestione di sistemi di clustering e segmentazione avanzata basati su machine learning (unsupervised).
Esecuzione di analisi comportamentali sui clienti finalizzate a migliorare acquisition, retention e valore del customer lifecycle.
Creazione di framework analitici per ottimizzare targeting, personalizzazione e comunicazioni CRM.
Conduzione di analisi sperimentali e A/B test sui principali touchpoint.

Data Visualization & Performance Reporting

Sviluppo e governance di dashboard strategiche in Tableau su KPI cliente, CLV, engagement e performance campagne.
Costruzione di metriche avanzate e modelli di attribution per misurare l'impatto delle iniziative CRM.

Data Management & Data Quality

Collaborazione con IT per garantire disponibilità, integrità e scalabilità dei dataset cliente.
Definizione dei requisiti per nuove fonti dati e processi di data enrichment.
Supervisione dell’integrazione dati tra sistemi legacy, CRM platform e data warehouse.

Supporto Strategico & Cross‑team Leadership

Partner strategico del team CRM per definizione di logiche di personalizzazione, journey e automazioni.
Supporto nella definizione di strategie basate su machine learning e insight avanzati.




Competenze tecniche:

Esperienza consolidata: 5+ anni in Data Science, Customer Analytics, CRM Analytics o ruoli simili.
Ottima conoscenza di SQL e gestione di dataset complessi (big data, multi-touchpoint).
Padronanza di Python o altri tools per modellistica statistica e machine learning.
Esperienza comprovata nello sviluppo di:
modelli predittivi (churn, CLV, propensity)
clustering avanzato e segmentazione comportamentale
regressioni e modelli classificatori
Solida capacità di costruire dashboard e KPI complessi in Tableau.
Conoscenza delle logiche CRM, loyalty, database marketing e customer lifecycle.
Plus: esperienza con piattaforme di automazione marketing e modelli LLM applicati all’analisi clienti.




Soft skills

Approccio analitico rigoroso e orientamento alla risoluzione di problemi complessi.
Capacità di rendere comprensibili e azionabili insight tecnici per stakeholder non tecnici.
Mindset strategico con attenzione al dettaglio.
Ottime doti comunicative e capacità di lavorare in team cross‑funzionali.
Proattività, autonomia e orientamento all'innovazione.




Cosa offriamo:

Un ruolo chiave nella trasformazione customers data-driven dell’azienda
Possibilità di lavorare con tecnologie moderne.
Opportunità di guidare la costruzione di modelli e framework analitici avanzati.
Ambiente dinamico, collaborativo e con forte orientamento all’innovazione.




Contratto a tempo indeterminato
Inquadramento livello Quadro CCNL Commercio
Il livello di inquadramento e la retribuzione saranno commisurati all’esperienza e alla completezza del profilo rispetto alle attività e alle competenze previste dal ruolo. Retribuzione annua lorda di riferimento tra € 45.000 e € 50.000
Variabile commisurato al livello offerto
Buoni pasto Satispay da € 6
Sconto dipendenti del 25% su parafarmaci e prodotti dermocosmetici (fino a 3.000 € annui)




Sede di lavoro: Milano.

Tipo di impiego: Full-time con 1gg di SW alla settimana.

Title: AI Engineer - Google
Description:
Entra nel nostro mondo.

Trasforma insieme a noi.

AI ENGINEER – GOOGLE  

Quale sarà la tua sfida?

Entra a far parte di Datwave, la company BIP che lavora verticalmente su piattaforme Google Cloud (GCP), specializzata in consulenza e servizi innovativi in ambito Intelligenza Artificiale, Cloud, Dati e Martech. 

La figura dell’AI Engineer progetta soluzioni software di Machine Learning (ML) scalabili per i casi d'uso dei clienti e le industrializza per l’esecuzione in produzione garantendo i livelli richiesti di performance, sicurezza e governabilità.

L’AI Engineer lavora a stretto contatto con altre figure di Datwave, come Cloud Data Architects, Data Scientists e Data Engineer, per realizzare soluzioni ML di alta qualità sotto ogni aspetto: disegnando e implementando per il team strumenti di lavoro come le piattaforme di MLOps, fornendo linee guida e best practise sulle architetture dati e di AI, supportando l’implementazione del software e funzionalità di osservabilità dell’AI, e altro ancora.

Oltre al focus sulle progettualità, ai/alle AI Engineer sarà richiesto un contributo attivo per alimentare la Community tramite attività di ricerca, scouting, concept di nuove soluzioni e business development. Per questo, sarà fondamentale tenere un approccio sempre propositivo e orientato alla presentazione di nuove idee che, dopo una co-valutazione interna, potranno essere proposte ai nostri clienti. 

Sarai tu a entrare nel nostro team?

 Requisiti fondamentali


Da 3 a 6 anni di esperienza nel ruolo;
Laurea specialistica in Ingegneria Informatica, Data Science, Informatica o discipline affini (STEM);
Esperienza nell’utilizzo della piattaforma Google Cloud;
Esperienza nello sviluppo di software in almeno un linguaggio, come per esempio: Python, Scala, Java, e/o simili;
Esperienza nel disegno di soluzioni software e nell’implementazione di strutture dati, algoritmi;
Esperienza nell’utilizzo degli strumenti di Code Repository, come per esempio: GitHub, GitLab, Azure DevOps e/o simili.
Conoscenza dei concetti, algoritmi e metodologie di Machine Learning.
Esperienza con linguaggi SQL per il design, query e gestione dei database; esperienza nell’utilizzo di linguaggi SQL per le attività di ETL.
Indispensabile la conoscenza fluente di Italiano e Inglese professionali.


Plus


Esperienza nell’utilizzo delle piattaforme cloud (esempio: Google, AWS, Azure);
Conoscenza dei concetti e tecnologie di Big Data e Data Warehousing (esempio: Hadoop, Spark, Hive, Kafka);
Esperienza con framework e metodologie di Deep Learning (esempio: Tensorflow, Torch, Caffe, Theano).


 

Perché Bip?


Crescita e Formazione
Più di 300 corsi su tecnologie e business emergenti, programmi di sviluppo personalizzati e iniziative di training e people care per supportare la tua crescita professionale e personale.
 
Flessibilità e Work-Life Integration
Lavoro agile con possibilità di programmare le giornate da remoto e in ufficio con il proprio responsabile e in base alle esigenze di progetto, Banca Ore Solidale per usufruire o mettere a disposizione ore di permesso a colleghi e colleghe che vivono momenti di difficoltà e una cultura che favorisce l’equilibrio tra vita e lavoro.
 
Salute & Benefits 
Assicurazione sanitaria, check-up agevolati, piattaforme per il benessere psicofisico e un piano welfare integrativo. Ticket restaurant e altri benefit dedicati.
 
Famiglia e Genitorialità
Supporto concreto a neogenitori: integrazione al 100% per i primi 3 mesi del congedo parentale o bonus una tantum, giorni extra per i papà e iniziative di supporto durante il congedo e al rientro in azienda.
 
Inclusione e Valori
Promuoviamo l’unicità e garantiamo pari opportunità a tutte le persone. Lavoriamo per un ambiente etico, equo e accogliente, anche attraverso politiche attive per le categorie protette (L. 68/99).


Cosa offriamo / What we offer

La retribuzione prevista per questa posizione è compresa tra € 34.000 e € 48.000 lordi annui, in funzione dell'esperienza, delle competenze e del livello di seniority del candidato.

L'inquadramento sarà definito durante il processo di selezione sulla base del profilo individuato e nel rispetto della normativa e del CCNL Metalmeccanici Industria

La retribuzione indicata si riferisce alla sola RAL (Retribuzione Annua Lorda).

Il pacchetto complessivo può includere ulteriori componenti variabili, correlate al raggiungimento di specifici obiettivi individuali e/o aziendali, welfare e benefit aziendali. La proposta economica finale sarà definita in base alle caratteristiche del profilo selezionato e alla coerenza con i requisiti della posizione.

Next Steps

Una volta ricevuto il tuo cv ci prenderemo del tempo per valutarlo attentamente.

Se c’è un match con questa o con altre posizioni aperte all’interno del Gruppo, ti contatteremo per iniziare la nostra conoscenza reciproca.

Su di Noi

Nati nel 2003, abbiamo raccolto e valorizzato l’esperienza storica della consulenza e abbiamo aggiunto due ingredienti chiave: l’innovazione e la digitalizzazione.

Grazie a questo percorso siamo oggi oltre 5000 professionisti, presenti in 13 Paesi, con oltre 4500 progetti alle spalle e le conoscenze più all’avanguardia nell'ambito della Digital Transformation, Data Science, Cybersecurity, Industry 4.0, IOT e di tutte le Disruptive Technologies che mettiamo a servizio di ogni settore di mercato.

Aiutiamo i nostri clienti a fare la differenza creando qualità su larga scala attraverso una formula che opera su tre leve: Valore, Persone e Tecnologia.

Crediamo nel valore dell’eccellenza, che è la bussola su cui orientiamo il nostro agire, e adottiamo un approccio etico e leale nei confronti di quante e quanti scelgono di lavorare con noi, promuovendo un ambiente in cui le persone possano crescere insieme, grazie alla contaminazione tra competenze diverse.

Title: Global AI Engineering
Description:
Campari Group today is a major player in the global branded spirits industry, with a portfolio of over 50 premium and super premium brands, marketed and distributed in over 190 markets around the world, with leading positions in Europe and the Americas.

Headquartered in Milan, Italy, Campari Group owns 25 plants worldwide and has its own distribution network in 26 countries, and employs approximately 4,700 people.

Shares of the parent company Davide Campari - Milano N.V. are listed on the Italian Stock Exchange since 2001. Campari Group is today the sixth-largest player worldwide in the premium spirits industry.

Mission Statement

The Global AI Engineer is responsible for accelerating the adoption and industrialization of Artificial Intelligence across Campari Group by designing, developing and scaling AI-powered solutions, intelligent assistants and autonomous agents that enhance productivity, automate business processes and unlock measurable value. The role contributes to establishing the foundations of an enterprise-wide Agentic AI ecosystem, maximizing the return on existing data and AI investments and supporting sustainable business growth.

General Description Of The Role

Within the Technology & Services organization, in the AI, Data & Analytics team, the role is responsible for enabling data-driven decision making and accelerating business value through data, analytics and Artificial Intelligence capabilities. As Artificial Intelligence rapidly evolves from predictive analytics into Generative AI and Agentic AI, the organization requires dedicated engineering capabilities to transform AI opportunities into scalable, secure and enterprise-ready solutions.

The Global AI Engineer plays a critical role in designing, developing, deploying and operationalizing AI-powered applications, intelligent assistants and autonomous agents that enhance employee productivity, automate knowledge work and support strategic business initiatives across Commercial, Supply Chain, Finance, HR and Corporate Functions.

The role acts as the technical bridge between business stakeholders, data teams and technology platforms, translating AI use cases into scalable solutions integrated within the enterprise ecosystem. The AI Engineer is responsible for accelerating the industrialization and adoption of AI capabilities, ensuring that solutions are secure, governed, reusable and aligned with business priorities.

Key Responsibilities And Activities

AI Solutions Design & Development


Design, develop and deploy Generative AI applications, intelligent assistants and AI agents to support business processes and decision-making.
Translate business requirements into scalable AI architectures and technical solutions.
Develop reusable AI components, prompts, workflows and orchestration frameworks that can be leveraged across multiple functions and markets.
Contribute to the evolution of a standardized and scalable AI application architecture.


Agentic AI Enablement


Design and implement AI agents capable of executing multi-step workflows and interacting with enterprise systems.
Support the development of autonomous and semi-autonomous AI solutions that augment employees and automate knowledge-intensive activities.
Contribute to the definition and implementation of agent orchestration, reasoning and monitoring frameworks.
Identify opportunities to increase process efficiency through Agentic AI capabilities.


Enterprise Integration & Automation


Integrate AI solutions with enterprise applications, data platforms and collaboration tools.
Collaborate with Data Platform, Enterprise Architecture and Application teams to ensure seamless integration and scalability.
Support the development of API-based integrations and automation workflows that enable AI solutions to operate effectively within the enterprise ecosystem.
Ensure interoperability between AI, Automation and Data & Analytics platforms.


AI Governance, Security & Reliability


Implement AI governance principles, security controls and monitoring mechanisms in line with company standards and compliance requirements.
Ensure AI solutions are reliable, scalable, explainable and aligned with responsible AI principles.
Monitor AI application performance and continuously optimize solution effectiveness and user adoption.
Support the establishment of AI engineering standards, best practices and development frameworks.


Stakeholder Partnership & Value Realization


Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify, prioritize and deliver high-value AI use cases.
Support business functions in assessing feasibility, business value and implementation approaches for AI initiatives.
Drive the industrialization of proofs of concept and pilots into production-ready solutions.
Contribute to measuring business impact, adoption and value realization from AI investments


Innovation & Continuous Improvement


Stay informed about emerging AI technologies, frameworks and industry trends.
Evaluate new tools, models and platforms that can strengthen the company's AI capabilities.
Promote AI knowledge sharing and support capability-building initiatives across the organization.
Contribute to strengthening Campari Group's internal AI engineering capabilities while reducing dependency on external partners


Required Skills And Experience

Experience & Background


5+ years of experience in Software Engineering, Data Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering or AI Engineering roles.
Proven experience developing and deploying AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions in enterprise environments.
Experience working with cloud-based AI ecosystems and modern data platforms.
Demonstrated experience delivering scalable applications from concept to production.
Experience collaborating with cross-functional business and technology teams in international organizations.


AI & Data Engineering Skills


Strong knowledge of Generative AI architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) patterns.
Experience building AI copilots, virtual assistants and agent-based solutions.
Understanding of prompt engineering, agent orchestration frameworks and AI application lifecycle management.
Experience designing scalable AI and data pipelines.
Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, knowledge retrieval and semantic search concepts.


Technical Skills


Hands-on experience with Azure AI Services, Azure OpenAI, Databricks and modern cloud-native architectures.
Strong programming skills in Python and modern software development practices.
Experience working with APIs, integrations, microservices and automation platforms.
Familiarity with DevOps, MLOps and AIOps practices.
Understanding of data governance, cybersecurity and enterprise architecture principles.


Business Skills


Ability to translate business challenges into practical AI solutions.
Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities.
Ability to prioritize initiatives based on business value and feasibility.
Strong communication skills with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.


Education


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science or related fields.
Relevant certifications in Cloud, Data Engineering or Artificial Intelligence are considered a plus.


Key Competencies


Strong innovation mindset and passion for emerging technologies.
Ability to combine technical excellence with business value creation.
Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.
Structured and analytical problem-solving approach.
Accountability and ownership mindset.
Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous and rapidly evolving environments.
Collaboration and teamwork across global and cross-functional teams.
Continuous learning attitude and intellectual curiosity.
Results-oriented approach focused on delivering measurable outcomes.
Strong communication and storytelling capabilities when explaining AI concepts to business audiences.
Fluent English.


The indicative annual gross salary (base salary) for this position ranges within 50K-62K + 10% STI, depending on the candidate’s experience, skills, and overall profile.

The role is classified in accordance with the collective labor agreement – level 2.

The position might also include a variable compensation component and a benefits package in line with applicable company policies.”

Our commitment to Diversity & Inclusion:

At Campari Group we believe in building more value together, thus we see diversity in all forms as a source of enrichment. Our employment policies and practices ensure that we are committed to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment without regard to any individual’s race, religion, creed, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or characteristics or expression, political affiliation or activity, age, veteran status, citizenship, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Campari Group believes that fair compensation and equal opportunities are crucial for employees’ well-being, empowerment, and engagement. Our efforts to ensure fair pay have earned us the Fair Pay Certification by Fair Pay Workplace, an independent organization dedicated to dismantling pay disparities based on gender, race and their intersection.

Note to applicants:

Your application will be assessed based on your abilities, expertise, general knowledge and experience, not because of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information you may possess. You must not disclose to Campari Group any such information. In the event that you are asked a question that cannot be answered without disclosure of any confidential, proprietary or trade secret information (including from a current or prior employer or their vendors or customers), you must decline to answer the question.

Notice to third party agencies:

Please refrain from cold-calling or emailing our executive leadership team or the HR community directly. The Talent Acquisition department manages centralized recruiting operations globally, including the selection and management of external suppliers. Currently, our preferred supplier list is at full capacity. To ensure we have your information on file for future consideration, we kindly request that you complete the online form provided here.
