Title: Data Scientist - GenAI
Description:
Join Artefact Belgium: Shape the Future of Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)

Are you an early-career professional excited to harness the power of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs)? Artefact Belgium is seeking a Data Scientist - Gen AI to join our innovative team in Brussels. Our Belgian team specializes in LLM and GenAI projects, and this is your chance to work on cutting-edge solutions, collaborate with top-tier experts, and contribute to impactful projects in a dynamic, forward-thinking environment.

Who You Are

A recent graduate or professional with 1 to 3 years of experience, with hands-on experience working with LLMs and a passion for generative AI and NLP. Motivated to apply your technical expertise to real-world challenges in AI. Able to thrive in collaborative settings while independently driving your own workstreams. Eager to learn, grow, and push the boundaries of what's possible in AI innovation.

Who We Are

Artefact is a leading Data & AI consulting firm operating at the forefront of AI innovation. With a global presence, we help clients across industries—public health, manufacturing, etc. —leverage generative AI to achieve transformative outcomes. Our team in Belgium is specialized in LLM and GenAI projects, working on the most advanced applications of these technologies. At Artefact, we foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning, with a strong commitment to inclusivity and employee growth.

What You Will Do


Collaborate with the team to design, train, and fine-tune state-of-the-art models for client projects and internal tools.
Develop and integrate agentic AI solutions using tool calling, and emerging protocols like Model Context Protocol (MCP) to create autonomous, context-aware applications.
Research and implement innovative generative AI applications to solve complex business problems.
Design and implement comprehensive evaluation frameworks to measure LLM performance, establishing quality metrics and benchmarks that guide development decisions and ensure reliable, production-ready solutions.
Optimize the performance, scalability, and usability of LLM-powered products and tools.
Contribute to the deployment and maintenance of AI systems, including models, APIs, and supporting infrastructure.
Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions to shape impactful solutions.


What You Bring


A degree in computer science, mathematics, engineering, physics, or a related field.
Experience working with LLMs, generative AI, or advanced NLP applications (e.g., fine-tuning models, using frameworks like Hugging Face or OpenAI).
Strong programming skills in Python and familiarity with AI and NLP libraries.
Analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with an ability to address real-world challenges through AI.
Good communication skills in English, Dutch or French; additional languages are a plus.
A growth mindset, adaptability, and eagerness to work in a fast-paced, cutting-edge environment.


What We Offer


A competitive salary with benefits tailored for early-career professionals.
Hands-on experience with state-of-the-art LLM technologies in impactful projects.
A dynamic and supportive work environment that fosters creativity and professional development.
Resources for ongoing training, certification, and skill-building in generative AI and related fields.
A collaborative, inclusive workplace with access to global expertise through Artefact's network.


This position is based in Brussels.

Don't worry if you don't meet every criterion! We value passion, potential, and a commitment to innovation. If you're excited about generative AI and ready to grow your career, we'd love to hear from you!

I'm currently working alongside a legal technology company based in Ghent, who are actively looking for an AI Engineer to join their team. You'll be designing and implementing AI-driven capabilities that automate legal workflows, streamline document analysis, and enable smarter, more efficient use of legal data.




Responsibilities

Design, develop, and deploy AI and machine learning models for production-grade legal SaaS applications.
Build intelligent solutions using Generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) to automate legal processes and enhance product capabilities.
Develop robust data pipelines, feature engineering workflows, and AI services for processing large volumes of legal documents and structured data.
Implement AI-powered features including intelligent legal search, document classification, contract analysis, information extraction, summarisation, predictive analytics, and conversational AI.
Develop and optimise RAG pipelines and AI agents for legal research and knowledge retrieval.
Integrate AI models with APIs, cloud platforms, databases, and modern software architectures.
Ensure AI solutions meet high standards for accuracy, reliability, explainability, data privacy, and security.




Your Profile

2–8 years of experience in AI Engineering, Machine Learning Engineering, Data Science, or a similar role.
Strong Python development skills.
Experience building and deploying production-grade machine learning or AI solutions.
Hands-on experience with Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, RAG, AI agents, document intelligence, or information retrieval.
Understanding of data engineering concepts including ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, cloud data platforms, and data modelling.
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP.
Familiarity with frameworks and technologies such as LangChain, LangGraph, Hugging Face, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar is an advantage.
Experience working with legal, regulatory, compliance, or other document-heavy domains is a strong plus.
Fluent in English.




The Offer

Hybrid working with an office based in Ghent.
Opportunity to build next-generation AI solutions for the legal sector within an innovative SaaS environment.
Work with modern technologies including LLMs, Azure OpenAI, RAG, AI agents, Databricks, cloud-native AI services, and MLOps.
Competitive salary of up to €6,500 per month, depending on experience.
Company car or mobility budget.
13+ ADV days.
Continuous learning, technical training, and certification opportunities.
Clear progression into Senior AI Engineer, AI Architect, or Technical Lead roles.
A collaborative engineering culture where innovation, technical ownership, and impact are encouraged.




If this opportunity excites you and you'd like to help shape the future of AI-powered legal technology, apply today or send your CV and a short cover letter to ryan.martin@vividresourcing.com.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
About Eno Health




Eno Health is an AI-powered platform designed to be the ultimate decision-support system for healthcare providers seeking to facilitate personalised care and long-term wellness for patients. We are building a compliant, secure, and European-sovereign biomedical AI solution for personalised healthcare. The platform streamlines practitioners' workflows and patient data processing, enabling faster, more precise clinical decisions.




Role Description




You will own the data-science layer of a regulated clinical AI system: the models, the evaluation methodology, and the statistical rigour behind the knowledge graph. This is not a dashboards-and-churn-models role. The problems are causal reasoning over structured clinical knowledge, mapping messy real-world lab data onto biomedical ontologies, and evaluating a fine-tuned biomedical LLM to a standard that survives a medical-device audit.




You will work with clinical, engineering and product colleagues to turn clinical knowledge into computable, testable artefacts. Expect a mix of modelling, ontology work, evaluation design, and writing, as every model decision at ENO needs to be documented, reviewed by a named human, and reproducible. Clinical sign-off gates what enters the knowledge graph; your job is to provide clinicians the statistical evidence to sign off.




This is a full-time hybrid role based in the Brussels Metropolitan Area, with some flexibility for remote work.




Qualifications




Advanced Python and PyTorch; experience taking models from experiment to production. Our inference stack is self-hosted (vLLM); familiarity with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (LoRA/QLoRA) of open medical or biomedical LLMs is a strong advantage.
Grounding in probabilistic graphical models; Bayesian networks, causal inference (structural causal models, do-calculus, or counterfactual reasoning). Our core asset is a causal clinical knowledge graph; this is the reasoning substrate you will work on daily.
Experience with property graph databases (Neo4j preferred): graph data modelling, graph algorithms (PageRank, random walks), and retrieval over structured knowledge (graph-RAG architectures).
Working knowledge of biomedical ontologies and terminologies (eg. SNOMED CT, LOINC/UCUM, Mondo, HPO, or equivalents) and the practical realities of mapping messy clinical and lab data onto them.
Applied statistics for model evaluation: experimental design, hypothesis testing, calibration, and error analysis and the discipline to document it. Model validation at ENO feeds a medical-device technical file (EU MDR, IEC 62304); reproducibility and named-reviewer sign-off are requirements of the job, not aspirations.
Experience with large, sensitive datasets in healthcare or a similarly regulated domain; fluency in GDPR Article 9 constraints, pseudonymisation, and data-minimisation trade-offs.
Master's or PhD in a quantitative field, or equivalent practical experience.
Federated or distributed learning: training and evaluating models across data silos that cannot be centralised. Our sovereign architecture keeps patient data inside per-country cells; learning across cells without moving personal health data is where this platform is heading.
Privacy-enhancing technologies beyond access control: differential privacy, secure aggregation, and conceptual command of homomorphic encryption (enough to reason about what is feasible, at what cost, and when it is the wrong tool).
Streaming data experience (Kafka/Flink) for clinical, lab, and wearable ingestion pipelines.
FHIR R4 and clinical interoperability standards.
Understanding of functional or systems medicine, or P4 (predictive, preventive, personalised, participatory) medicine frameworks.




What We Offer




A foundational role in a clinical AI platform at the stage where architecture decisions are still being made and yours to influence.
Competitive salary and an equity package.
Hybrid working from our Brussels base, with flexibility for remote work.
Direct collaboration with the founding team and clinical leadership.

Title: Senior Machine Learning Engineer
Description:
Over Comobi,




Comobi revolutioneert de personenvervoersector door intelligente passagiersclustering te combineren met premium comfort. We bouwen aan de mobiliteitsoplossing van de toekomst: een klantgerichte dienst die het comfort van individueel vervoer biedt, maar dan duurzamer, efficiënter en betaalbaarder.Als ontwikkelaar van de mobiliteit van morgen starten we bij luchthavens en internationale stations om uit te groeien tot een mondiaal "Physical Internet" voor (gedeeld) personenvervoer.

Jouw Rol,Als Data Scientist ben je het brein achter onze intelligente clustering. Je bouwt de modellen die bepalen welke reizigers wanneer samen reizen, langs welke route en tegen welke prijs. Elke verbetering aan jouw algoritmes vertaalt zich rechtstreeks in meer comfort voor onze klanten, lagere kosten en minder CO2 op de weg.




Kernverantwoordelijkheden,

Modellering & Optimalisatie

Clusteringalgoritmes ontwikkelen: Reizigers slim groeperen op basis van bestemming, tijdstip, voorkeuren (privacy, flexibiliteit, kosten/CO2-impact) en beschikbare capaciteit
Route- en ritplanning optimaliseren: Modellen bouwen voor dynamische routering, ophaalvolgorde en voertuiginzet
Vraagvoorspelling: Passagiersstromen voorspellen op basis van vluchtschema's, treindiensten, seizoenspatronen en historische data
Dynamische prijszetting: Prijsmodellen ontwikkelen die de balans tussen comfort, kosten en bezettingsgraad bewaken
Impact meten: CO2-besparing, kostenefficiëntie en klanttevredenheid kwantificeren en rapporteren

Data & Samenwerking

Datapijplijnen opzetten: Samen met het tech-team zorgen voor betrouwbare, schaalbare dataverwerking van boekingen, ritten en externe bronnen
Van prototype naar productie: Modellen integreren in ons mobiliteitsplatform en hun prestaties in de praktijk opvolgen
Cross-functionele samenwerking: Nauw samenwerken met product, operations en sales om inzichten om te zetten in concrete beslissingen
Communicatie: Complexe analyses helder vertalen naar het team en het management




Wie Zoeken We?

Essentiële Kwalificaties

Analytische achtergrond: Bachelor/Master in data science, statistiek, wiskunde, informatica, (bio-)ingenieurswetenschappen of gelijkwaardig door ervaring
Programmeren: Vlot in Python (pandas, scikit-learn, NumPy) en SQL
Machine learning: Ervaring met clustering, voorspellende modellen en/of optimalisatietechnieken
Probleemoplossend: Een vaag operationeel vraagstuk kunnen vertalen naar een concreet, meetbaar model
Communicatief sterk: Resultaten begrijpelijk maken voor niet-technische collega's

Pluspunten

Optimalisatie: Kennis van operations research, vehicle routing problems (VRP) of combinatorische optimalisatie
Geodata: Ervaring met geografische data, routing-API's of kaartdiensten
Cloud & MLOps: Ervaring met het deployen en monitoren van modellen in productie
Domeinkennis: Affiniteit met mobiliteit, logistiek of transportplanning




Ervaring: Deze rol is geschikt voor zowel gedreven starters als ervaren professionals. We bekijken het loon naar gelang je ervaring en competenties.




Persoonlijke Eigenschappen

Nieuwsgierig: Je wil begrijpen waarom een model werkt, niet alleen dat het werkt
Pragmatisch: Je kiest de oplossing die vandaag impact heeft boven de perfecte oplossing van volgend jaar
Ondernemend: Hands-on mentaliteit, je wacht niet tot de data perfect is
Resultaatgericht: Focus op meetbare verbetering voor klant, kosten en klimaat
Flexibel: Comfortabel in een dynamische start-up omgeving







Wat Bieden We?

Impact: Jouw modellen bepalen letterlijk hoe onze dienst rijdt, vanaf dag één
Ownership: Ruimte om de data-strategie en de technische keuzes mee vorm te geven
Groei: Meegroeien met een ambitieus bedrijf richting internationale schaalvergroting
Innovatie: Werken aan een uniek optimalisatieprobleem op het kruispunt van mobiliteit, duurzaamheid en technologie
Team: Samenwerken met gepassioneerde professionals die geloven in onze missie




Praktische Info,




Werklocatie: Gent

Hybride werken: Thuiswerk mogelijk in afspraak met het team

Contract: Voltijds, vast contract




Klaar om de mobiliteit van morgen slimmer te maken?

Stuur je CV en motivatiebrief naar pieter@comobi.be

Title: Data & Simulation Specialist
Description:
Cartamundi is wereldmarktleider in “play”-oplossingen. Denk aan speelkaarten, kaart- en bordspellen, collectibles en trading card games.

Ons doel? “Live Different, Play Different” voor iedereen. Met bijna 3.000 mensen zetten we ons elke dag in om die ambitie waar te maken. Ons familiebedrijf, met hoofdkantoor in België, heeft daarvoor een wereldwijd netwerk van designcenters, verkoopkantoren en productiefaciliteiten. Een netwerk dat loopt van de VS en Brazilië tot Europa en Japan.

Cartamundi heeft een wereldwijde merkenportefeuille met heritage brands zoals Bicycle®, Bee®, Copag®, Shuffle® en heel wat lokaal geliefde merken. We zijn ook de vertrouwde partner van toonaangevende speelgoed- en entertainmentbedrijven voor productie- en distributieoplossingen.

De drukpersen van Cartamundi draaien al sinds 1765. We koppelen die rijke traditie aan innovatie in digitale en hybride speelervaringen. Om zo relevant te blijven – vandaag en morgen.

Cartamundi voert een strategie van duurzame en winstgevende groei. Op die manier streven we ernaar om onze planeet en ons bedrijf in topconditie te houden voor de komende generaties.




Lees meer op www.cartamundi.com

Volg ons op LinkedIn: www.linkedin.com/company/cartamundi




Data & Simulation Analyst

Als Data & Simulation Analyst ben je verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van complexe en unieke klantbehoeften naar correcte, efficiënte en productieklare collatieschema’s voor collectible kaartenproducten.

Je zorgt ervoor dat alle kaartvarianten in de juiste aantallen, samenstellingen en configuraties in flowpacks, decks en displays terechtkomen, in lijn met zowel klantverwachtingen als productietechnische mogelijkheden.




Jouw functie

Met jouw analytische blik en technische feeling…




…Vertaal je klantbehoeften naar haalbare oplossingen

Je analyseert klantwensen en adviseert op basis van technische en statistische inzichten.




…Ontwerp je collatieschema’s van A tot Z

Je ontwikkelt vorm-, lay‑out- en dropschema’s en zorgt voor correcte kaartcombinaties.
Je maakt scenario­berekeningen voor duidelijke keuzes en alternatieven.




…Lever je sterke simulaties en analyses

Je bouwt displaysimulaties op basis van kansberekening.
Je maakt impactanalyses en rapporten die beslissingen ondersteunen.




…Bewaak je data en kwaliteit

Je houdt namelists en control sheets up-to-date.
Je voert nauwkeurige 4‑eyes checks uit.




…Optimaliseer je tools en processen

Je verbetert bestaande tools en workflows en ondersteunt toolontwikkeling.




…Communiceer je vlot met interne partners

Je stemt af met Sales en productie en maakt technische info begrijpelijk voor iedereen.




Jouw profiel

Je bent voor ons de ideale kandidaat omdat je…

Denkt op masterniveau en een wetenschappelijke of wiskundige achtergrond hebt.
Sterke analytische skills hebt en vaardig bent in statistische berekeningen.
Nauwkeurig werkt, een oog hebt voor detail en steeds gaat voor topkwaliteit (4 eyes mindset zit in jouw DNA).
Complexe materie helder kan uitleggen en graag meedenkt in oplossingen.
Uitblinkt in Excel. Basis tot programmeervaardigheden is mooi meegenomen.
De taal van zowel Sales als Productie begrijpt en deze werelden moeiteloos met elkaar verbindt.
Proactief verbeterkansen ziet en graag werkt aan efficiëntere processen en slimmere tools.
Je jezelf vlot kan uitdrukken in het Nederlands en Engels.




Aanbod

We bieden je de uitdaging om zelfstandig een boeiende en gevarieerde job uit te oefenen. Je komt terecht in een dynamische onderneming en een hecht team waar je kan werken in een aangename werksfeer. Je krijgt de mogelijkheden jezelf te ontwikkelen. Het salarispakket is in overeenstemming met je ervaring en de verantwoordelijkheden van de functie.




Interesse?

Toe aan een nieuwe uitdaging? Surf naar www.cartamundi.com/nl/careers en solliciteer online.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
Description:
Bij Christeyns zetten we data om in waardevolle inzichten. Als internationale B2B-speler in de hygiënechemie investeren we sterk in een toekomstgerichte data-omgeving die onze bedrijfsprocessen en duurzaamheidsambities ondersteunt.




Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist. In deze rol krijg je de kans om je analytische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en stap voor stap door te groeien naar een functie als Business Analyst. Je werkt mee aan projecten die een directe impact hebben op de werking en besluitvorming binnen onze internationale organisatie.




Jouw functie

Je vertaalt ruwe en complexe data uit verschillende interne en externe bronnen naar heldere, bruikbare inzichten voor proceseigenaars en management, zodat beslissingen onderbouwd en datagedreven kunnen worden genomen.
Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt dashboards, datamodellen en API’s die bedrijfsprocessen meetbaar, stuurbaar en transparant maken binnen een internationale organisatie.
Je werkt actief mee aan de verdere uitbouw en optimalisatie van de data-architectuur en -infrastructuur, waarbij betrouwbaarheid, performantie en schaalbaarheid centraal staan.
Je ontsluit data via gebruiksvriendelijke visualisaties en rapporteringen in tools zoals Power BI en Grafana, ondersteund door Databricks en Microsoft Azure.
Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor duurzaamheids- en ESG-gerelateerde data en zorgt voor correcte definities, consistente datasets en duidelijke rapportering ter ondersteuning van strategische doelstellingen.
Waar relevant pas je machine learning en geavanceerde analysetechnieken toe om patronen te identificeren, inzichten te verdiepen en data verder te verrijken.
Je stemt noden en verwachtingen rond data, visualisatie en voorspellende modellen af met proceseigenaars en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met IT en het data team.
Je rapporteert aan de Data Team Lead




Jouw profiel

Bachelor of Master in Data Science, Toegepaste Informatica, Handelsingenieur, Economie of een vergelijkbare richting;
Je bent een starter of hebt een eerste relevante ervaring via stage, studentenjob of een eerste werkervaring;
Interesse in data-analyse, bedrijfsprocessen en business intelligence;
Basiskennis van SQL, Power BI of Python is een pluspunt;
Interesse om door te groeien richting Business Analytics;
Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels.




Ons aanbod

Een uitdagende startersfunctie binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie;
Begeleiding en opleiding door ervaren collega's;
Werken in een jong en dynamisch data team;
Ruimte voor initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en professionele groei;
Een marktconform salarispakket met extralegale voordelen.




Wie zijn wij?

Christeyns is een Belgische specialist in hygiëne- en reinigingsoplossingen voor onder meer wasserijen, de voedingsindustrie, schoonmaakbedrijven en de gezondheidszorg. De groep combineert de ontwikkeling en productie van reinigings- en desinfectieproducten met apparatuur, engineering, digitale toepassingen en technische dienstverlening.




Met meer dan 1.800 medewerkers en 47 dochterondernemingen wereldwijd rapporteerde Christeyns in 2025 een omzet van meer dan 487 miljoen euro. Het familiebedrijf werd opgericht in 1946 en is sinds 1989 in handen van de familie Bostoen.




Meer informatie: christeyns.com




Interesse?

Wil je je carrière starten in data en analytics en doorgroeien naar een Business Analyst-rol binnen een internationale organisatie?




Stuur je cv en motivatie naar jobs@christeyns.com. We kijken ernaar uit om je te leren kennen.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Data Scientist to join an innovative team working at the intersection of data, human behavior, and advanced analytics.







In this role, you will leverage large-scale sensor, operational, and customer-related datasets to uncover meaningful behavioral patterns and generate actionable insights. You will apply advanced statistical, machine learning, and AI techniques to solve complex real-world challenges, transforming raw data into practical and explainable business value.




This is an exciting opportunity for a curious and autonomous professional who enjoys combining analytical rigor, applied research, and stakeholder collaboration to drive impactful results.




Key Responsibilities




Analyze large and complex datasets from connected systems, operational environments, and customer feedback sources.
Design and develop interpretable features and behavioral dimensions to identify patterns, trends, and user profiles.
Combine multiple data sources, including structured and unstructured data, to generate richer insights and predictive capabilities.
Evaluate, compare, and validate analytical approaches suchas:
Clustering
Dimensionality reduction
Factor analysis
Correlation analysis
Supervised and unsupervised machine learning models
Conduct proof-of-concept studies to rapidly assess the applicability and value of new methodologies.
Review scientific literature and industry best practices to identify innovative approaches that can be adapted to business challenges.
Validate model performance, robustness, reliability, and limitations using sound statistical practices.
Collaborate with engineering, technical, and business stakeholders to ensure findings are relevant, actionable, and aligned with operational realities.
Present insights, recommendations, assumptions, and limitations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.




Required Qualifications




Master's degree or PhD in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative discipline.
Approximately 4-8 years of hands-on experience in Data Science, Advanced Analytics, Machine Learning, or Applied AI.
Strong expertise in Python for data analysis, machine learning, experimentation, and rapid prototyping.
Solid knowledge of statistics, machine learning, and AI techniques, including: Feature engineering
Model validation
Dimensionality reduction
Predictive modeling
Pattern discovery
Ability to work independently, structure analytical approaches, and challenge assumptions when results are unclear or inconclusive.
Experience applying analytical methods to complex, real-world datasets rather than solely relying on standard modeling pipelines.
Strong critical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.
Excellent communication skills with the ability to explain complex concepts in a clear and accessible way.
Business-oriented mindset with a focus on delivering practical and explainable outcomes.




Nice to Have




Experience working with connected systems, IoT, sensor, mobility, industrial, or operational data.
Exposure to customer analytics, behavioral analysis, survey data, persona development, or user experience analytics.
Experience with modern data platforms and technologies such as:
SQL
Snowflake
Databricks Similar cloud-based analytics environments
Knowledge of Large Language Models (LLMs), Generative AI, or AI-assisted analytics.
Experience in interdisciplinary environments combining data science, engineering, and product development.




What we have to offer




At Akkodis, we want to give you the right environment to develop your expertise and grow throughout your career. You can count on:

A permanent contract
An attractive compensation package, including 13.92 months of salary
A company car or mobility budget, depending on your package
A flexible cafeteria plan
Hospitalization insurance
Training and development opportunities to strengthen both your technical and professional skills
A structured onboarding and regular follow-up, including career discussions and support from your managers
Access to technical communities and experts to exchange knowledge and develop your expertise
Referral and business bonuses when you contribute to growing our teams and business
Opportunities to develop your career across different projects, technologies, and areas of expertise

Title: AI Model Engineer
Description:
🌍 We’re making security suck less for developers.

Security tools haven’t kept up with how software is built today. They interrupt teams, slow releases, and turn security into a bottleneck instead of a capability. We built Aikido to change that. Aikido builds developer-first security products that reduce real risk without getting in the way of shipping software. We focus on what actually matters and automate the rest.

We’re taking on legacy security tools teams have been stuck with, and we’re winning. If you want to help us take market share and build products developers actually enjoy using, you’re in the right place.

Founded in 2022 by third-time founders, Aikido has $85M in the bank and a long runway ahead. We’re building toward self-securing software. Join an all-star team. Take real ownership. Push boundaries. Build things that matter.

We’re looking for an AI Model Engineer to join our AI Pentest team. You’ll evaluate newly released open-source models and adapt the best ones specifically for Aikido’s code auditing and pentesting workflows.

Responsibilities

Scout and evaluate new open-source AI models.

Fine-tune, distill, quantize, or prune models for Aikido’s security agents.

Build benchmarks that measure vulnerability discovery, accuracy, tool use, speed, and cost.

Optimize and deploy models on our multi-GPU infrastructure.

Work with AI engineers and security researchers to bring validated improvements into production.

Strong Python and PyTorch skills.

Experience fine-tuning or adapting open-source LLMs.

Experience with Hugging Face and inference systems such as vLLM.

Strong experimental and engineering skills.

Self-starter who works well without rigid structure.

Experience with security agents, CUDA/Triton, MoE models, distillation, quantization, or REAP.

What you can expect

Short decision lines. Big ownership. Shape the projects that matter and ship fast.

Grow as fast as we do. Take on more, own more, and carve out your own path.

Top-tier tech pay and equity.

High trust, strong values, zero corporate BS.

Flexibility in working hours.

A company that sticks to its values in an open and informal atmosphere.

We hire for talent, drive, and potential. Everything else is noise.

Title: Junior Data Scientist
HTML:
Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist.


Christeyns is een Belgische specialist in hygiëne- en reinigingsoplossingen voor onder meer wasserijen, de voedingsindustrie, schoonmaakbedrijven en de gezondheidszorg. De groep combineert de ontwikkeling en productie van reinigings- en desinfectieproducten met apparatuur, engineering, digitale toepassingen en technische dienstverlening.


Met meer dan 1.800 medewerkers en 47 dochterondernemingen wereldwijd rapporteerde Christeyns in 2025 een omzet van meer dan 487 miljoen euro. Het familiebedrijf werd opgericht in 1946 en is sinds 1989 in handen van de familie Bostoen.


Functieomschrijving


Bij Christeyns zetten we data om in waardevolle inzichten. Als internationale B2B-speler in de hygiënechemie investeren we sterk in een toekomstgerichte data-omgeving die onze bedrijfsprocessen en duurzaamheidsambities ondersteunt.


Om ons data team verder te versterken, zoeken we een enthousiaste Junior Data Scientist. In deze rol krijg je de kans om je analytische vaardigheden verder te ontwikkelen en stap voor stap door te groeien naar een functie als Business Analyst. Je werkt mee aan projecten die een directe impact hebben op de werking en besluitvorming binnen onze internationale organisatie.


Jouw functie


  • Je vertaalt ruwe en complexe data uit verschillende interne en externe bronnen naar heldere, bruikbare inzichten voor proceseigenaars en management, zodat beslissingen onderbouwd en datagedreven kunnen worden genomen.
  • Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt dashboards, datamodellen en API's die bedrijfsprocessen meetbaar, stuurbaar en transparant maken binnen een internationale organisatie.
  • Je werkt actief mee aan de verdere uitbouw en optimalisatie van de data-architectuur en -infrastructuur, waarbij betrouwbaarheid, performantie en schaalbaarheid centraal staan.
  • Je ontsluit data via gebruiksvriendelijke visualisaties en rapporteringen in tools zoals Power BI en Grafana, ondersteund door Databricks en Microsoft Azure.
  • Je neemt verantwoordelijkheid voor duurzaamheids- en ESG-gerelateerde data en zorgt voor correcte definities, consistente datasets en duidelijke rapportering ter ondersteuning van strategische doelstellingen.
  • Waar relevant pas je machine learning en geavanceerde analysetechnieken toe om patronen te identificeren, inzichten te verdiepen en data verder te verrijken.
  • Je stemt noden en verwachtingen rond data, visualisatie en voorspellende modellen af met proceseigenaars en werkt hiervoor nauw samen met IT en het data team.
  • Je rapporteert aan de Data Team Lead


Profiel


  • Master in Data Science, Toegepaste Informatica, Handelsingenieur, Economie of een vergelijkbare richting;
  • Je bent een starter of hebt een eerste relevante ervaring via stage, studentenjob of een eerste werkervaring;
  • Interesse in data-analyse, bedrijfsprocessen en business intelligence;
  • Basiskennis van SQL, Power BI of Python is een pluspunt;
  • Interesse om door te groeien richting Business Analytics;
  • Zeer goede kennis van Nederlands en Engels.


Aanbod


  • Een uitdagende startersfunctie binnen een internationale en groeiende organisatie;
  • Begeleiding en opleiding door ervaren collega's;
  • Werken in een gemotiveerd en dynamisch data team;
  • Ruimte voor initiatief, persoonlijke ontwikkeling en professionele groei;
  • Een marktconform salarispakket met extralegale voordelen.

Title: Senior Data Scientist
Description:
Job description




Let's build the future of AI & Data, together 🧙




At Data Wizards, we're focused on 3 things: Data, AI & you.




We're a small team who genuinely love digging into data that makes a real difference for the companies we work with, and who want to discover how AI and data can help companies out there.




Why join us? Apart from tackling exciting challenges with passionate people in an environment that wants to see you thrive, you'll be part of a young company that keeps its feet on the ground, its eyes on the stars, and believes the best growth comes from the unique magic each Wizard brings.




We are continuously on the lookout for bright data engineers, data scientists, machine learning engineers, AI engineers, and data analysts. But this job description is for Senior Data Scientists out there feeling the magic in them and ready to spread it 🪄




We are currently looking for a senior data scientist for a fraud detection project where you would do:




Strengthening our fraud models by improving how we collect, label, structure and engineer features from complex transactional and behavioral data
Designing, building and continuously refining fraud detection models using machine learning, graph analytics, anomaly detection and behavioral analytics
Turning large volumes of transactional and customer data into actionable fraud intelligence through feature engineering, data enrichment and pattern discovery
Partnering with Fraud Operations, Risk, Compliance and Product teams to spot emerging fraud trends and translate business needs into scalable analytical solutions
Digging into complex fraud schemes, uncovering new attack vectors and building proactive detection strategies that protect the business financially and reputationally
But being a consulting company, we can't know in advance what your exact responsibilities will be




Job requirements




You’re a step closer to joining our team if you bring:




Background




At least 5 years of experience in data science, with a solid grounding in fraud detection, ideally within the financial sector
A Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, computer science or engineering. A PhD is a plus, and candidates with a different academic background but strong analytical skills are equally welcome




Technical Skills




Hands-on experience processing large-scale, complex transactional and behavioral datasets using SQL, Python (Pandas) and distributed processing frameworks such as Spark or Hadoop
Proven ability to apply supervised and unsupervised machine learning, anomaly detection, graph analytics and network analysis to detect, investigate and prevent fraud. Experience with generative AI is a plus
Strong Python skills, with experience deploying AI applications into production; familiarity with Java is a plus




Soft Skills




Autonomous & Proactive: You take initiative and drive projects forward.
Curious & Adaptive: You embrace learning and thrive in dynamic environments.
Solution-Oriented: You balance technical rigor with business impact.
Clear Communicator: You simplify complex ideas for diverse audiences.
Collaborative & Supportive: You work well in teams.
Creative Thinker: You find innovative solutions to challenging problems.
Languages: Fluent in English, French and/or Dutch.




We know that finding the right job isn’t just about the role, it’s about what’s in it for you, too. While we’re a start-up, we’re big on taking care of our people right from day one.




Here's a sneak peek at what we offer:




💰 A compensation package that keeps you motivated




Competitive salary
Mobility budget or company car with an electrical card
30 days of paid time off
A top-tier laptop & smartphone with a subscription
Representation allowances
Group, hospitalization & dental insurance
Meal vouchers & eco-cheques
Opportunity to earn company stock over time




🌱 A place to be your best self, grow, and thrive




Work with the most innovative technologies in Data & AI
Work in an agile, collaborative environment
Hybrid work model: up to 3 days per week
Monthly team-building events (plus one epic annual celebration)
Tailored training programs to fuel your career growth
A cool, ergonomic office with creative meeting spaces, a Nintendo Switch for spontaneous Mario Kart battles, a massage chair for those deep-thinking moments and fresh coffee & drinks to keep you energized ☕




✨ And most importantly, an organic-growing company where you are in control of your own path!




Our Recruitment Process:




📲Quick intro call with our HR team (5')

💜Culture check: HR Interview (30')

🛠️Technical check: Wizard assessment (25') & Technical Interview with our wizards (1h)

🤝Partner Meet-up (30')




Why this process?

We want you to get a genuine feel for who we are, and we want to make sure we're aligned on what truly matters. Rather than rushing the process, we focus on finding the right fit, so that six months from now, both sides are still convinced they made the right decision.




➡️If you're passionate about what we do but aren't sure you meet every single requirement, don't hesitate to apply. We value potential, mindset, and growth as much as experience. At Data Wizards, we believe diversity is our strength. We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences because different viewpoints help us grow and evolve.




➡️Please note: As a consulting company, our recruitment process can be either project-driven or based on strong profiles we believe in. The consultancy world moves fast, and while we always aim to match great talent with the right opportunity, there might not always be an immediate fit. With your permission, we'll gladly keep your profile in mind for future missions, and hope to collaborate with you soon on an exciting project at Data Wizards!

Title: Data analyst connectivity
Description:
Your role

“Data mining” is a trend you can’t miss these days. The use of data is becoming more and more standard in different domains like product design or decision making.

Your role is to support other teams with your data analyses skills. Your focus point will be on “connectivity” data, but the requests can be very diverse. Many of our products are connected to the cloud, most of our products have digital twins, all our designs are created in a digital environment. There are plenty of opportunities to find relations, correlations, and influences to improve our products, processes or reporting tools. The knowledge and learnings are shared with the product development teams or other stakeholders like the service division or managment

Some Examples


Could we improve the quality of our machines by standardizing on specific items that appear to be more reliable than others?
What is a typical operating regime for a certain type of machines?
Are our machines performing as expected?
Do we get a lot of safety warning due to a clogged filter from a specific supplier?
At which average outlet pressure do our machines operate at 1000m above sea level?


To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.


Master's degree in Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, or a related technical or scientific field.
Programming in Python (PySpark) and SQL is a must, basic knowledge of other programming languages is required
Experience in cloud computing, data analysis and signal processing is required
Notion of version control system, database structures and modeling techniques
Knowledge of Matlab, Power query and PowerBI is a plus
Interest in AI and the latest trends and evolutions in data science is a plus


In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees' development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow. Here, your ideas are embraced, and you never stop learning.

You will have a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. You will also have access to global job opportunities, as part of the Atlas Copco Group. We offer an interesting compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Antwerp, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Title: AI Developer
Description:
Ready to Join the Backstage Crew?




At Bleckmann, we’ve been delivering on promises since 1862. As a market leader in supply chain management for fashion and lifestyle brands, we keep the show running behind the scenes — from moving boxes to moving data, from pack & ship to IT and HR.




But we’re not just logistics experts. We’re The Backstage Crew — a tight-knit team of 6,500+ people who make fashion and lifestyle brands shine by doing the work that matters most, out of the spotlight but never out of impact.




Whether you're on the warehouse floor or behind a screen, you’ll find:




Strong connections with colleagues who support and celebrate you.
Fast growth in a company that’s expanding across Europe, the US, and Asia.
High energy in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.
Guided freedom to take initiative, solve problems your way, and grow your career.




We believe in entrepreneurship, expertise, excellence, and engagement — and we live these values every day. From repairing returned goods to reducing waste, we help brands extend product lifecycles with sustainability in mind.




So if you’re ready to roll out the red carpet for our clients — and for each other — we’ve got a spot for you.




Behind the scenes is where the real excitement begins. Ready to join us?




About the job

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence and eager to build solutions that create real business impact?

At Bleckmann, we are building a dedicated AI capability to drive innovation and efficiency across our global operations. As an AI Developer, you will translate business challenges into intelligent solutions using AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Microsoft Copilot technologies.

Working closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, IT teams, and external partners, you will help shape the future of AI within an international and fast-growing organization.




Your role

As an AI Developer, you design, develop, and implement AI-powered solutions that improve business processes, enhance decision-making, and create measurable value.

You will work on innovative use cases, intelligent agents, AI automations, and machine learning applications while ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives.




Your responsibilities

AI Solution Development

Design, develop and implement AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions based on business needs and strategic priorities.
Build scalable AI applications, intelligent agents and automation workflows that create measurable business value.
Develop, test, deploy and maintain AI models and AI-powered solutions, ensuring reliability, performance and scalability.
Translate prototypes and Proof of Concepts into business-ready applications that can be adopted across the organization.
Integrate AI capabilities into existing business processes, systems and reporting environments.
Continuously optimize and improve existing AI solutions based on performance, user feedback and evolving business requirements.

Business Partnership & Use Case Development

Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, decision-making and customer experience.
Translate complex business challenges into practical and sustainable AI solutions.
Assess the feasibility, expected impact and business value of new AI initiatives.
Support the definition and prioritization of the AI roadmap by contributing ideas, expertise and innovation opportunities.
Facilitate workshops, brainstorming sessions and AI discovery initiatives to help business teams uncover new use cases.

Data & AI Engineering

Work closely with Data Engineers and BI teams to leverage reliable, governed and business-aligned data sources.
Design feature engineering and data preparation logic to ensure optimal model performance.
Ensure AI solutions are integrated efficiently within the broader data ecosystem and existing platforms.
Contribute to the development of reusable AI components, frameworks and best practices.
Help ensure AI solutions are built on high-quality, trustworthy and scalable data foundations.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

Stay up to date with the latest developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI.
Explore new technologies, platforms and methodologies to continuously improve AI capabilities within Bleckmann.
Evaluate innovative tools and concepts through experiments, pilots and Proof of Concepts.
Share knowledge and best practices with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization.
Contribute to building a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous learning.

Governance & Responsible AI

Ensure all AI solutions comply with governance, security, privacy and data protection requirements.
Apply responsible AI principles, including transparency, explainability and reliability.
Validate outputs and implement safeguards to minimize risks such as hallucinations, bias or incorrect recommendations.
Document solutions, assumptions and limitations to ensure transparency and maintainability.
Support the organization's commitment to trustworthy and responsible AI adoption.

Collaboration & Delivery

Work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, Data Engineers and external partners to successfully deliver AI initiatives.
Contribute actively within an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
Communicate progress, risks, dependencies and outcomes clearly to stakeholders.
Support solution deployment, user adoption and continuous improvement after go-live.
Act as a trusted advisor on AI-related topics and help drive the successful adoption of AI across the organization.




Your profile

What you bring

Experience with Python, SQL, and AI/ML development
Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or Copilot solutions
Knowledge of Prompt Engineering, RAG, Embeddings, and Vector Search
Experience working with cloud platforms and data environments such as Snowflake
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Ability to translate business needs into practical AI solutions
Strong communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities
Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and emerging AI technologies

Nice to have

Experience with Snowflake AI capabilities (Cortex, Snowpark)
Experience with MLOps and model lifecycle management
Experience within logistics, supply chain, or operational environments
Knowledge of AI governance, GDPR, and responsible AI practices




What we offer

The opportunity to help build and shape Bleckmann’s AI capability from the ground up
A high-impact role within a fast-growing international organization
The chance to work on innovative AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI use cases
Collaboration with business stakeholders, IT teams, Data Engineers, and external experts
An entrepreneurial environment where innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged
Opportunities for professional growth, development, and continuous learning
A collaborative culture where knowledge sharing and ownership are valued
A competitive salary package with attractive benefits




At Bleckmann, we are guided by our values: We take a parachute and jump (Entrepreneurship), we unpack our knowledge (Expertise), we raise the bar with every box (Excellence), and we spark energy that connects (Engagement).

  • Fast growth in a company that’s expanding across Europe, the US, and Asia.
  • High energy in a dynamic environment where no two days are the same.
  • Guided freedom to take initiative, solve problems your way, and grow your career.


We believe in entrepreneurship, expertise, excellence, and engagement — and we live these values every day. From repairing returned goods to reducing waste, we help brands extend product lifecycles with sustainability in mind.


So if you’re ready to roll out the red carpet for our clients — and for each other — we’ve got a spot for you.


Behind the scenes is where the real excitement begins. Ready to join us?


About the job

Are you passionate about Artificial Intelligence and eager to build solutions that create real business impact?

At Bleckmann, we are building a dedicated AI capability to drive innovation and efficiency across our global operations. As an AI Developer, you will translate business challenges into intelligent solutions using AI, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Microsoft Copilot technologies.

Working closely with business stakeholders, Data Engineers, IT teams, and external partners, you will help shape the future of AI within an international and fast-growing organization.


Your role

As an AI Developer, you design, develop, and implement AI-powered solutions that improve business processes, enhance decision-making, and create measurable value.

You will work on innovative use cases, intelligent agents, AI automations, and machine learning applications while ensuring solutions are scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives.


Your responsibilities

AI Solution Development

  • Design, develop and implement AI, Machine Learning and Generative AI solutions based on business needs and strategic priorities.
  • Build scalable AI applications, intelligent agents and automation workflows that create measurable business value.
  • Develop, test, deploy and maintain AI models and AI-powered solutions, ensuring reliability, performance and scalability.
  • Translate prototypes and Proof of Concepts into business-ready applications that can be adopted across the organization.
  • Integrate AI capabilities into existing business processes, systems and reporting environments.
  • Continuously optimize and improve existing AI solutions based on performance, user feedback and evolving business requirements.

Business Partnership & Use Case Development

  • Collaborate closely with business stakeholders to identify opportunities where AI can improve efficiency, decision-making and customer experience.
  • Translate complex business challenges into practical and sustainable AI solutions.
  • Assess the feasibility, expected impact and business value of new AI initiatives.
  • Support the definition and prioritization of the AI roadmap by contributing ideas, expertise and innovation opportunities.
  • Facilitate workshops, brainstorming sessions and AI discovery initiatives to help business teams uncover new use cases.

Data & AI Engineering

  • Work closely with Data Engineers and BI teams to leverage reliable, governed and business-aligned data sources.
  • Design feature engineering and data preparation logic to ensure optimal model performance.
  • Ensure AI solutions are integrated efficiently within the broader data ecosystem and existing platforms.
  • Contribute to the development of reusable AI components, frameworks and best practices.
  • Help ensure AI solutions are built on high-quality, trustworthy and scalable data foundations.

Innovation & Continuous Improvement

  • Stay up to date with the latest developments in Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Generative AI and Agentic AI.
  • Explore new technologies, platforms and methodologies to continuously improve AI capabilities within Bleckmann.
  • Evaluate innovative tools and concepts through experiments, pilots and Proof of Concepts.
  • Share knowledge and best practices with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization.
  • Contribute to building a culture of innovation, experimentation and continuous learning.

Governance & Responsible AI

  • Ensure all AI solutions comply with governance, security, privacy and data protection requirements.
  • Apply responsible AI principles, including transparency, explainability and reliability.
  • Validate outputs and implement safeguards to minimize risks such as hallucinations, bias or incorrect recommendations.
  • Document solutions, assumptions and limitations to ensure transparency and maintainability.
  • Support the organization's commitment to trustworthy and responsible AI adoption.

Collaboration & Delivery

  • Work closely with business stakeholders, IT teams, Data Engineers and external partners to successfully deliver AI initiatives.
  • Contribute actively within an Agile/Scrum environment, participating in sprint planning, stand-ups and retrospectives.
  • Communicate progress, risks, dependencies and outcomes clearly to stakeholders.
  • Support solution deployment, user adoption and continuous improvement after go-live.
  • Act as a trusted advisor on AI-related topics and help drive the successful adoption of AI across the organization.


Your profile

What you bring

  • Experience with Python, SQL, and AI/ML development
  • Experience with Generative AI, LLMs, AI agents, or Copilot solutions
  • Knowledge of Prompt Engineering, RAG, Embeddings, and Vector Search
  • Experience working with cloud platforms and data environments such as Snowflake
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to translate business needs into practical AI solutions
  • Strong communication skills and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Passion for innovation, continuous learning, and emerging AI technologies

Nice to have

  • Experience with Snowflake AI capabilities (Cortex, Snowpark)
  • Experience with MLOps and model lifecycle management
  • Experience within logistics, supply chain, or operational environments
  • Knowledge of AI governance, GDPR, and responsible AI practices


What we offer

  • The opportunity to help build and shape Bleckmann’s AI capability from the ground up
  • A high-impact role within a fast-growing international organization
  • The chance to work on innovative AI, Machine Learning, and Generative AI use cases
  • Collaboration with business stakeholders, IT teams, Data Engineers, and external experts
  • An entrepreneurial environment where innovation and continuous improvement are encouraged
  • Opportunities for professional growth, development, and continuous learning
  • A collaborative culture where knowledge sharing and ownership are valued
  • A competitive salary package with attractive benefits


At Bleckmann, we are guided by our values: We take a parachute and jump (Entrepreneurship), we unpack our knowledge (Expertise), we raise the bar with every box (Excellence), and we spark energy that connects (Engagement).

Title: Data Engineer (h/f)
Description:
Contexte et environnement

TotalEnergies a l’ambition de se positionner en tant qu’acteur majeur de la transition énergétique.

La branche GRP est pleinement engagée au service de cette ambition et se transforme pour permettre à la Compagnie de devenir un électricien intégré dans un marché en croissance et orienté positivement.

Pour cela, la branche GRP a créée nouvellement une Business Unit depuis juillet 2023.

Cette nouvelle BU a pour missions de :


Se positionner en tant qu’expert interne sur les marchés de l’électricité et définir la stratégie Electricité de la Compagnie;
Assurer le marketing des actifs renouvelables de la Compagnie et optimiser leur valeur ;



Au sein de cette nouvelle Business Unit, la direction Tech&Transfo fournit les solutions informatiques à nos métiers et à nos clients externes. La ligne de Service Data And Reliability Team a notamment la charge de l’ensemble des projets DATA des filiales RPG FR et RPG BE.

Activités


Concevoir, développer et maintenir les architectures de données (data pipelines, data warehouses, data lakes).
Collecter, nettoyer, transformer et structurer les données provenant de différentes sources (internes et externes).
Assurer la qualité, la sécurité et l’intégrité des données.
Optimiser les performances des systèmes de traitement de données.
Mettre en place des processus d’automatisation pour l’ingestion et le traitement des données.
Documenter les flux de données, les modèles et les procédures.
Analyser les données et développer des solutions BI pour les visualiser et fournir des informations exploitables.
Construire des algorithmes complexes et élaborer des modèles prédictifs afin d’anticiper les comportements des clients ;
Analyser les données pour en extraire les informations les plus utiles au Groupe et les restituer de manière visuelle ;
Travailler conjointement avec les équipes Marketing, Vente, Energie Management…. Afin de comprendre leurs besoins et élaborer des modèles qui répondent à leurs problématiques
Faire de la veille technologique, et proposer les solutions techniques.
Rédiger les documentations nécessaires (Techniques et fonctionnelles), et les fiches de tâches au support pour assurer un bon suivi de la production



Profil du candidat

Formation supérieure (de type BAC+5 ingénieur ou universitaire)

2+ années d’expérience dans le domaine de la Data

Bonnes connaissances des environnements décisionnels et de leurs contraintes de fonctionnement et de service, de l’alimentation à la restitution


ML, Intelligence artificielle, modèles supervisés, modèles non supervisés, modèles d'apprentissag e par renforcement (obligatoire).
Python (panda, udf, …), SQL, Databricks, Devops, Java



Qualités personnelles :


Autonomie
Rigueur, capacité d’analyse et de synthèse
Esprit d’équipe
Bon relationnel
Sens du service et des responsabilités

Title: AI Engineer
Description:
🤖 The Job

At Dataroots, we deliver end-to-end data and AI solutions, from strategy and platform design to data engineering and AI-enabled systems. That broad scope is reflected in our team: AI/ML engineers, data engineers, cloud architects, and data strategists. Each discipline brings its own expertise, but we share knowledge, perspectives, and a common way of thinking across disciplines.

Within that team, you design, build and deploy AI solutions that deliver tangible business value for our clients across a variety of industries, spanning classical ML, modern GenAI, and Agentic AI use cases. Your work goes beyond getting the models to work; you help bring AI systems into production in a robust and scalable way, applying best practices in MLOps and LLMOps to ensure they are reliable, maintainable, and adaptable over time.




💼 What we’re looking for

You bring the following qualities & experiences to the role:

A deep passion for Artificial Intelligence and its applications.
A minimum of 2 years of experience developing AI-driven applications or systems.
Strong foundation in software design principles; Proficiency in Python & SQL is a must.
A solid understanding of core machine learning techniques and how to apply them pragmatically in production settings.
Familiarity with modern generative AI and agentic approaches, including retrieval-based systems and LLM orchestration patterns.
Experience deploying AI systems into production, with a solid grasp of model lifecycle management and cloud-native deployment practices.
Experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and a solid understanding of cloud-based AI and data workflows.
Front-end experience is considered a plus.
Strong communication skills and the ability to simplify complex technical concepts for clients.
A pragmatic, business-oriented mindset: able to translate business problems into technical scopes and help AI solutions land, with a focus on product thinking and real business value.
Fluency in English and Dutch.




Not every box needs to be ticked to be a great fit. If you’re excited about the role and eager to grow, we’d still love to hear from you.




🎉 Why choose Dataroots?

We’re a data & AI consulting company where people, growth, and impact go hand in hand. Since our early days, we’ve built a culture that values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and an environment where individuals can thrive. This focus has allowed us to grow steadily while staying true to what matters: delivering meaningful results for our clients and creating a place where people enjoy doing their best work.

Working at Dataroots means gaining exposure to a wide range of industries, challenges, and technologies. You’ll have the opportunity to step outside your comfort zone, while being supported by experienced colleagues who are always ready to share their expertise.

As part of the Talan Group, we further extend these opportunities by offering an international dimension to your career path.




💰 The Offer

An attractive salary with extralegal benefits, including:

+ Mobility budget or a company car with fuel/charging card

+ Hospitalisation and group insurance

+ High-end laptop

+ Smartphone with subscription

+ Substantial amount of holidays

+ Meal vouchers

+ ...

Diverse and welcoming work environment, where you’ll collaborate & unwind with colleagues from different cultures and disciplines. The organization of both fun & professional events and initiatives is actively encouraged and supported.
A training budget for individual and team learning opportunities.
Tons of team-building events and sports initiatives to stay connected and unwind.




📍 Where you’ll work

Our main offices are in Leuven and Ghent. These spaces are perfect for both focusing and unwinding with colleagues, as well as brainstorming sessions and team events.

While much of your work can be performed remotely, you will also work on-site with clients.




🎯 Ready to join Dataroots?

Excited to shape the future of AI with us? We’re looking forward to hearing from you! Apply now and start a new chapter as AI/ML Engineer at Dataroots! 🎉

Title: Decision Intelligence Developer
Description:
Can’t wait to make an impact on the world? You’re not alone. Join us in driving progress in the working world and beyond.

Your journey with us

We’re seeking a talented Data Skill Builder to join our Supply Chain Data Team. In this role, you’ll be the bridge between complex data systems and actionable insights—extracting, transforming, and visualizing data from diverse sources to fuel intelligent decision-making. You’ll work closely with architects and business stakeholders to build robust data pipelines and compelling analytics that drive supply chain optimization. If you’re passionate about turning raw data into business value and thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced environment, this is your opportunity to make a tangible impact.

What You’ll Do


Data Extraction & Integration: Extract data from multiple enterprise systems (ERP, WMS, TMS, planning tools) and third-party sources; design and build reliable data pipelines that consolidate information into unified datasets
Data Analysis & Transformation: Perform exploratory data analysis, identify data quality issues, and transform raw data into clean, structured formats ready for analytics and modeling
Analytics Development: Develop analytical queries, dashboards, and reports that surface key insights; translate business questions into data-driven answers
Data Visualization: Create compelling visualizations and interactive dashboards (Tableau, Power BI) that communicate complex data stories to business stakeholders in clear, actionable ways
Collaboration with Architects: Work closely with Solution Architects to understand technical requirements; implement data solutions according to architectural specifications and best practices
Data Quality & Governance: Implement data validation checks, monitor data quality, and maintain documentation; ensure data consistency and reliability across systems
Continuous Learning: Stay current with data engineering tools, analytics techniques, and emerging technologies; contribute ideas for improving data processes and methodologies


Let's Talk About You


Data Engineering Fundamentals: 3+ years of hands-on experience building data pipelines, ETL processes, and working with SQL and relational/non-relational databases
Programming Proficiency: Strong experience with Python, SQL, or similar languages; ability to write clean, maintainable code and debug technical issues independently
Analytics & Visualization: Demonstrated expertise with analytics tools (Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and statistical analysis; ability to translate data into compelling visual narratives
Cloud & Data Platforms: Familiarity with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, GCP) and experience working with data warehouses, data lakes, or big data platforms (Spark, Hadoop)
Problem-Solving Mindset: Strong analytical thinking; ability to break down complex data challenges and find practical solutions with minimal guidance
Communication Skills: Ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders; comfortable presenting findings and collaborating across teams
Passion for Data: Genuine curiosity about data; track record of delivering data projects that drove measurable business insights or operational improvements


Primary Focus: Data Excellence Over Platform Specificity

While Familiarity With Aera Technology Is a Nice-to-have, Data Engineering And Analytics Expertise Is What Matters Most. We Value Professionals Who


Prioritize data quality, pipeline reliability, and analytical rigor above platform-specific knowledge
Can quickly learn new tools and platforms as business needs evolve
Understand when to build custom solutions vs. leverage existing platforms
Bring deep experience with core data technologies: Python, SQL, cloud data warehouses, BI tools, and ML frameworks


Supporting Technologies

Data & Analytics : Python, SQL, Spark, Kafka, TensorFlow, PyTorch, scikit-learn, XGBoost

Cloud Platforms: AWS, Azure, GCP

Data Warehousing: Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift, Delta Lake

Visualization & BI: Tableau, Power BI, Looker

DevOps & Deployment: Git, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines

Collaboration: Jira, Confluence, design tools

Our story

Enterprise Performance is about achieving maximum impact and value from investments in finance, supply chain, and IT operations requires a holistic view of key business functions from strategy through process design and technology enablement

Deloitte is a globally recognized professional services firm committed to making an impact that matters. Our Supply Chain & Network Operations practice supports clients in addressing their most critical supply chain challenges through strategic, analytical, and technology-enabled projects. We deliver end-to-end, data-driven redesign and digitization to transform key areas such as planning, sourcing & procurement, manufacturing, and logistics & distribution. Join our team in Belgium and work with clients across diverse industries as we advise, implement, and operate solutions that drive sustainable growth and operational excellence.

Who is Deloitte?

We provide industry-leading audit and assurance, tax and legal, consulting and related services. We are committed to driving innovation across offerings to help our clients address their challenges, while giving our professionals opportunities to learn and grow in this era of transformation.

In Belgium, +5000 dedicated professionals active in +10 offices, take great pride in bringing multidisciplinary expertise to a wide variety of clients, from national and international companies, small, fast-growing and large organizations to public institutions and governmental authorities.

Why Deloitte?

Be the true you! We foster diversity and inclusion and encourage you to bring your authentic self to work. Explore, question and collaborate while building a career that inspires and energises you.

Never stop growing! Diversity of thought makes us stronger. At Deloitte, we tailor a personalized learning experience, offering you the opportunity to grow at your own pace and achieve maximum impact.

We practice what we preach! As a Purpose-led organisation, at the heart of everything we do is a set of timeless principles and unifying values .

Life looks different for each of us, so we created a varied benefits package that you can tap into:


My Benefits My Choice, a flexible rewards plan tailored to your lifestyle and priorities
Sustainable transport options offered by Mobility@Deloitte
Flexible work arrangements for all and initiatives supported by Parents & Caregivers @Deloitte
Wellbeing tips and activities powered by Energise@Deloitte
Topped off with other health benefits and insurance opportunities


Empowering our employees with flexible work arrangements remains essential in today's reality:


Hybrid workplace: combination of home office and on-site (+10 offices in Belgium or client's premises).
Part-time employment: all our jobs are open to full-time or part-time work under a 90% or 80% regime.


Join us to make an impact together! Apply now!

Title: Software Engineer - AI/ML
Description:
Company Overview

KLA is a global leader in diversified electronics for the semiconductor manufacturing ecosystem. Virtually every electronic device in the world is produced using our technologies. No laptop, smartphone, wearable device, voice-controlled gadget, flexible screen, VR device or smart car would have made it into your hands without us. KLA invents systems and solutions for the manufacturing of wafers and reticles, integrated circuits, packaging, printed circuit boards and flat panel displays. The innovative ideas and devices that are advancing humanity all begin with inspiration, research and development. KLA focuses more than average on innovation and we invest 15% of sales back into R&D. Our expert teams of physicists, engineers, data scientists and problem-solvers work together with the world’s leading technology providers to accelerate the delivery of tomorrow’s electronic devices. Life here is exciting and our teams thrive on tackling really hard problems. There is never a dull moment with us.

Group/Division

The Information Technology (IT) group at KLA is involved in every aspect of the global business. IT’s mission is to enable business growth and productivity by connecting people, process, and technology. It focuses not only on enhancing the technology that enables our business to thrive but also on how employees use and are empowered by technology. This integrated approach to customer service, creativity and technological excellence enables employee productivity, business analytics, and process excellence.

Job Description/Preferred Qualifications

We are seeking a highly skilled Software Engineer with specialized expertise in Machine Learning, Artificial Intelligence, and Data Science to join our innovative technology team. This role will be key in developing impactful AI solutions that drive business transformation and technological advancement. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical skills with business intelligence to translate complex requirements into practical, scalable applications that deliver measurable impact.

Key Responsibilities:


AI/ML Solution Development: Design, develop, and implement machine learning models and AI algorithms to address business challenges. This includes data preprocessing, model training, validation, and deployment.
Scalable Architecture Design: Architect and design scalable systems that can handle large volumes of data and complex AI/ML workloads, ensuring high performance and reliability.
Production-Ready Solutions: Implement AI/ML solutions that are robust, maintainable, and ready for production environments. This includes considerations for security, compliance, and operational efficiency.
Innovation and Research: Stay abreast of the latest developments in AI, ML, and data science. Conduct research to explore new methodologies or improve existing ones, ensuring our solutions remain innovative.
Collaboration: Work closely with multi-functional teams including data engineers, product managers, software developers, and business partners to integrate advanced solutions into our products and services, ensuring alignment with business objectives.
Problem Solving: Apply critical thinking to solve complex problems, often requiring innovative approaches to data analysis, model architecture, system integration, and business strategy.
Deployment and Monitoring: Oversee the deployment of AI/ML models into production environments, ensuring scalability, performance, and reliability. Monitor model performance post-deployment and iterate as necessary.
Documentation and Knowledge Sharing: Document processes, methodologies, and findings. Share knowledge through internal presentations, workshops, or by contributing to our knowledge base.



Preferred:


Experience with specialized AI domains or industry-specific applications.
Contributions to open-source projects or research publications in AI/ML.
Knowledge of AI ethics and responsible AI practices.



Minimum Qualifications


Master’s or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Data Science, AI, or a related field.
Minimum of 3 (three) years of experience in AI/ML, with a proven track record of deploying solutions in a production environment.
Proficiency in Python, R, or similar languages, with experience in libraries like TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn, etc.
Strong background in statistics, machine learning algorithms, deep learning, neural networks, and system architecture.
Strong understanding of cloud platforms, DevOps practices, and data processing technologies.
Demonstrated ability to lead technical projects and work effectively in matrix environments.
Ability to communicate technical concepts to non-technical team members and business partners.
Familiarity with software engineering best practices, including version control (Git), CI/CD pipelines, agile methodologies, and system design patterns.
